data.name: Subaku Palace
data.description: A forbidden art stolen from Subaku Castle that calls the demon palace into the waking world, sapping every enemy beneath its gates while pouring dark power into its master.
data.battleDescription: %user presses a palm to the earth, and a sigil of burning gold spirals outward across the battlefield. With a sound like grinding stone, gates of red sandstone carved with snarling faces tear free of the ground, and the shadow of the demon palace falls across the field. Beneath those gates strength drains away and every strike grows timid, while the palace pours its dark power into the one who summoned it. For a time the battlefield belongs to the demon palace, and to its master.

data.name: Dragon King's Impact
data.description: A forbidden jutsu that burns the user's own lifeforce into a fire dragon, sent climbing into the sky before it dives down on the target and leaves wounds that keep burning. For a short time the user's attacks hit harder, though their scorched body takes extra damage from every hit.

Its fire lingers in %target's wounds, while the lifeforce it burned leaves %user striking harder but scorched beneath every hit.

data.name: Asazakura – Sakura Dragon Tree
data.description:
Summons the legendary Sakura Dragon Tree—its darkened trunk erupting from the battlefield, crowned in blazing pink and violet flame blossoms.

The tree remains rooted in place, scorching nearby enemies and empowering all fire and scorch-based techniques used by the caster. Its presence marks the battlefield with beauty and devastation alike.

A symbol of rebirth and destruction, this is the first blossom of the Nikko no Hana's legacy.
data.battleDescription: Flames blossom from the earth as %user casts burning petals toward %target in a dazzling display of wrath and grace.

data.name: Magnetic Pulse Strike
data.description: A powerful Taijutsu strike that generates a magnetic pulse to disorient and damage the opponent.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers their chakra into their fists, charging it with magnetic energy. With a swift and precise movement, they strike %target directly. Upon impact, a shockwave of magnetic force radiates from the point of contact, distorting the magnetic fields around %target. This pulse disrupts their nervous system and balance, making them vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

data.name: Shadow Tether
data.description: Glowing tattoos summon shadows that deal a devastating wound to enemies
data.battleDescription: %user’s tattoos glow as living shadows stretch toward %target and tighten around them. The tether tears into %target, leaving a deep wound that makes every movement more painful.

data.name: Eternal Forest
data.description: Trap your enemy in a never ending Forest.
data.battleDescription: %user claps their hands together and releases a massive amount of chakra, the earth starts to shake and crack open as massive tree limbs start shooting upward into the sky. Suddenly a branch springs forth dragging %target into the path of the onrushing roots.

data.name: Incandescent Nova
data.description: Incandescent Nova showcases extreme control over the scorch release, summoning a radiant nova that converges on a target and evaporates a massive area in an instant.
data.battleDescription: %user performs a series of hand signs, unleashing a surge of chakra that forms a radiant nova around %target. The area rapidly evaporates as the nova converges inward, erupting in a devastating blast that inflicts lasting burns through simultaneous heat and dehydration.

data.name: Magma Slayer
data.description: This jutsu enables the user to conjure an incredible, dangerous ally from the molten depths to maul the target and leave lasting wounds.
data.battleDescription: %user utilizes the power of their lineage to conjure a humanoid magma form from the molten depths. As the husk arises, an incredible heatwave forms around the area. The husk emanates incredible temperatures and looks at %target with murderous intent as it prepares for the slaughter.

data.name: Kinetic Nova
data.description: A blast of explosive chakra that disrupts all other chakra in the area
data.battleDescription: %user condenses their chakra into a ball, flinging it at %target which explodes showering the area in the tiny explosions. %target soon realizes that its very hard to gather mold their elemental chakra.

data.name: Particle Cannon
data.description: The ultimate power comes with the ultimate price.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves an intricate triangle with their fingers, bringing forth a radiant orb that caresses %user's hand with a warm glow that both energizes and burns. Gradually, the sphere transforms, unfurling into a brilliant beam, propelled with purpose towards %target

data.name: Crystal Lance Strike
data.description: Summons a massive crystal lance to strike the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into the ground, summoning a massive, radiant crystal lance that reflects all colors of the spectrum, and with a commanding gesture, hurls it at %target, shattering the ground and sending shockwaves as it impales and crushes them, obliterating their defenses with its immense power.

data.name: Shattering Crystal Storm
data.description: Launches a barrage of crystal shards at the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user concentrates their chakra into their palms, forming a crystalline glow before unleashing a torrent of sharp, glistening shards that fly like a storm of daggers, piercing even the toughest armor and leaving %target wounded and disoriented amidst the relentless assault.

data.name: Jade
data.description: Crystal Jade's jutsu, utilizing a crystal sword.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses their chakra into an immense crystal prism, which shatters with a burst of power into countless razor-sharp fragments, scattering in a deadly storm around them

data.name: Prism
data.description: Channel the light from the sun to enlighten the battlefield
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a blinding prism of light, striking %target dealing a devastating blow leaving them wounded.

data.name: Crystal Sphere
data.description: Create a Sphere in which you protect yourself from all damage
data.battleDescription: %user encases themselves in a sphere made of pure crystal

data.name: Glacial Shatter: Purgatory
data.description: The user creates a wave of freezing energy that shatters across the surrounding area, damaging those caught within while the returning frost forms a protective shield around the user.
data.battleDescription: As %user invokes Glacial Shatter, a surge of frigid energy erupts around %target. The wave crashes and bursts across the surrounding area before the returning frost gathers into a protective shield around %user.

data.name: Gatekeeper: Drowning Anchor
data.description: %user slams the anchor down, crushing enemies caught close to the impact.
data.battleDescription: %user slams the anchor down, crushing enemies caught close to the impact.

data.name: Earth Wall
data.description: A massive wall of earth rises, forming an impenetrable defense.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hands onto the ground, channeling chakra deep into the earth. With a rumble, the ground shifts, and an immense wall of solid rock erupts from the earth, towering before them. The wall forms a seamless barrier, its surface craggy and unyielding, standing firm against the enemy’s incoming attack. Dust clouds swirl as the rock stabilizes, its defensive power unmatched, blocking everything in its path.

data.name: Revitalizing Pollen
data.description: The butterfly scatters luminous pollen over an ally, restoring health and lifting harmful effects.
data.battleDescription: %user uses Revitalizing Pollen on %target.

data.name: Resonant Wind Ward
data.description: A sheltering echo shields an ally.
data.battleDescription: %user folds a humming current of wind around %target as a shield.

data.name: Kinjutsu: Black Thorn Rose
data.description: A forbidden art paid for in the user's own blood. Black thorn vines lash out in a spiral, choking the healing of every enemy they catch, while the rose's thorns close around the user as armour.
data.battleDescription: %user opens their palm with a thorn and lets the blood fall. A black rose tears up through the earth, its vines spiralling outward to choke every wound they find, while its thorns curl back to armour the one who fed it.

data.name: Tranquil Guard Flowing Form
data.description: Honed through years of practising the staff, stand firm as you block all incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user flows into Tranquil Guard, staff held firm as a steady aura surrounds them. With each controlled strike, they deal measured damage while weakening %target’s power, their blows softened against the user’s guarded form.

data.name: Infernal Leash: Hellhound's Drag
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a guttural growl, conjuring a blazing tether from its jaws that ensnares %target. With a vicious yank, it drags its prey closer, leaving them vulnerable to its next attack.

data.name: Hellfang: Emberbound Shackles
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user lunges forward, sinking its smoldering fangs into %target. Cursed embers erupt into burning chains, rooting the victim in place while searing flames weaken their offensive power.

data.name: Oni's Death Lottery
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: "Foolish warrior you've gotten too close"  With a wicked grin, the %user draws a burning fortune from its sleeve and casts it toward %target. An unlucky fate unleashes hellfire that consumes its victim in an instant.

data.name: Cyclone Palm Strike
data.description: The user presses a whirling cyclone of chakra into the target with an open palm. The spinning force clings to them, so every attack hits them harder and burns a little deeper for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user plants a spinning cyclone of chakra on %target with an open palm, tearing their guard wide open.

data.name: Element Divine
data.description: Generate five cyclones of elemental chakra that collide with each other.
data.battleDescription: %user generates five cyclones of elemental chakra around %target. With precise control, each cyclone converges on %target.

data.name: Divine Elements
data.description: Generate 5 cyclones of elemental chakra that collides against each other.
data.battleDescription: %user generates 5 cyclones of elemental chakra around %target. With precise control each cyclones converges on %target

data.name: Black Coffin
data.description: Unite, repulse, fill the earth, and know your own powerlessness.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a sphere of intensified gravity centered around %target. The affected area appears shrouded in a swirling mass of pitch darkness with faint, glowing patterns resembling constellations, symbolizing the weight of the universe crushing down

data.name: Abyss of Shadows
data.description: Calls down a black sun of shadow whose crimson corona drinks the light from the battlefield. Beneath it the enemy grows slow and hollow, their strength and guard drawn into its void for a few precious moments.
data.battleDescription: %user raises a hand to the sky, and the light bleeds away as a black sun blooms above %target, its corona burning a deep and terrible crimson. Wisps of shadow spiral down from its rim and wind around %target, dragging them into a silence older than chakra itself. Beneath that dead star %target's strikes come slow and weightless, and their guard dissolves like mist drawn into the void. For a few precious moments, the black sun makes even the mightiest shinobi small.

data.name: Blazing Fang Strike
data.description: Unleashes a great fire dragon whose burning fangs pierce straight through any guard. The fire takes root in its prey and burns on long after.
data.battleDescription: Flame gathers in %user's hands until it can no longer be contained, coiling into a great fire dragon with jaws agape. With a roar that shakes the air, the dragon lunges across the battlefield and sinks its burning fangs straight through %target's guard as if it were paper. The bite does not end with the strike; the fire takes root deep within %target, flaring anew with every breath that follows.

data.name: Drops of Renewal
data.description: Summons a glowing rain that turns the enemy's blows into healing and swells the user's chakra.
data.battleDescription: %user lifts their face to the sky as a single drop of water falls, then another, then a shimmering rain that gathers around them in slow, glowing spirals. Every wound that reaches %user is drawn into the rain and returned as living water, mending flesh even as it is torn. Fed by the current, %user's chakra swells, and each strike they throw lands with the force of a river in flood. For a short while, %user becomes the eye of a healing storm.

data.name: Earthen Bastion
data.description: Calls the earth up to clad the user in a living fortress of molten-veined stone. Blows break against it, while every strike the user throws carries the weight of the mountain.
data.battleDescription: %user drives a heel into the ground, and the earth answers with a roar. Jagged plates of stone tear free of the battlefield and slam shut around %user, veined with molten light, a living fortress that moves as they move. Blows that land against it crack and scatter like rain on a cliff face, while every strike %user throws carries the weight of the mountain behind it. For as long as the stone holds, %user stands as immovable as the land itself.

data.name: Hollow Veil
data.description:
Casts a shroud of ash-gray mist over the enemy that drains the fire from their strikes and turns their fury into the user's strength.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: With a whisper from %user, a veil of ash-gray mist drifts across the battlefield and settles over %target like a funeral shroud. It hollows %target out from within, draining the fire from their strikes until even their fiercest blows fall weak and distant. What the veil takes, it gives to its maker: every wound %target lands on %user returns to them as quiet, restoring breath.

data.name: Tempest Cleave
data.description:
A spinning storm of razor wind that carves through everything around the user, friend and foe alike. Its cuts keep singing long after it fades.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user plants their feet and turns once, and the air itself becomes a blade. A storm of razor wind erupts outward in a howling ring, carving through everything within its reach, for the tempest knows no allegiance. Those caught in it are left with wounds that will not close, each cut still singing with the wind long after the gale has passed. In its wake, even the hardiest guard lies in ribbons.

data.name: Celestial Dew
data.description: Calls down a drop of starlight from a crescent moon that heals the user and wraps them in a silver ward.
data.battleDescription: %user closes their eyes and the night seems to answer, a pale crescent moon blooming into being above them. From its tip falls a single drop of starlight that splashes across %user and spreads into a dome of soft, silver light. Wounds knit closed beneath its glow as the dome settles into a quiet ward that swallows the blows meant for its keeper. Within it, for a few heartbeats, the battle seems very far away.

data.name: Shrapnel Clone Barrage
data.description:
The user sends a wave of clones rushing into the fray, each one bursting into chakra shrapnel on impact. The embedded fragments keep tearing at everyone caught in the blast over the next few rounds.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user sends a wave of clones charging at %target, and they detonate in a storm of chakra shrapnel that buries itself in everyone nearby.

data.name: Earth Release: Seven Heavenly Pillars
data.description: The user drives chakra into the ground and a ring of stone pillars erupts across an area, pounding enemies over the next few rounds. Those caught among the pillars are staggered, and their attacks lose force.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hands into the earth, summoning seven towering stone pillars that burst upward across the area. Anyone caught among them is crushed again and again and left staggered, their ability to strike effectively reduced.

data.name: Cursed Mirrorflame
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user dances behind a shimmering veil of molten fire, laughing as its opponent's attacks rebound in a shower of cursed embers.

data.name: Pinning Volley
data.description: A cluster of gilded bolts lands around the target, pinning clothing and limbs in place.
data.battleDescription: The Giltbolt Archer releases a cluster of gilded bolts that pins its target in place.

data.name: Twin Flame Cataclysm
data.description: You unleash twin streams of flame that strike the target, bind them in place and continue burning them over the next three rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user slams both tails into the ground, unleashing twin streams of flame that coil around %target. The flames bind %target in place, dealing damage and inflicting steady damage over time.

data.name: Core Directive: Reforge
data.description: Overwrites the Architect’s current form with the original divine design, surpassing all limitations—at a cost
data.battleDescription: %user activates Core Directive: Reforge on %target, tearing muscle and bone into forced compliance as their body is reshaped into an unstable prototype. The imposed design weakens %target's attacks and leaves them vulnerable to further damage.

data.name: Razor Water Whip
data.description: The user cracks a whip of razor-edged water that bursts over an area, slicing any enemy caught in its reach. The rush of water chakra lingers in the user's hands, making their Water attacks hit harder in the rounds that follow.
data.battleDescription: %user lashes out with a swift, bladed whip of condensed water chakra that carves into %target with razor precision. As the whip extends and recoils, it channels violent chakra flow through %user’s system, boosting the power of their water techniques for subsequent strikes.

data.name: Infernal Surge
data.description: Channeling searing flames, the user ignites their body and strikes, engulfing their foe in fire while fueling their own fire techniques with unrelenting heat.
data.battleDescription: A roar of flame erupts as %user's body ignites with blazing energy, surging forward in a torrent of fire. The onslaught engulfs %target, searing all it touches while each ember clings to %user, feeding their power and amplifying the fury behind every flame that follows.

data.name: Inferno Burst
data.description: The user hurls a dense knot of fire chakra that erupts over the area, scorching every enemy in the blast. The heat lingers on anyone caught inside, leaving them more vulnerable to fire for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user expels a high-speed blast of condensed fire chakra that detonates on impact with %target, scorching their body and chakra network. The heat lingers, disrupting their chakra defenses and increasing the damage they take from future fire techniques.

data.name: Final Arrow
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user draws their bow, channeling devastating chakra into four arrows before unleashing them into the battlefield. Each arrow crashes into the ground with overwhelming force, creating a deadly zone of destruction. As the four impacts converge, their combined power erupts in a catastrophic blast capable of killing %target in a single strike.

data.name: Thunder Chain Slash
data.description: The user snaps a lightning-charged chain weapon at the target in a sudden lashing slash. The jolt locks up their muscles, stunning them and costing them action points.
data.battleDescription: %user channels lightning chakra into a chained weapon and unleashes a sudden, snapping slash toward %target. The moment the weapon strikes, a burst of electricity erupts from the point of contact, locking up the enemy’s muscles with a violent jolt. The electric backlash leaves %target momentarily paralyzed, caught in the crackling wake of the chained assault.

data.name: Thunder Fist
data.description: The user charges a fist with violent static and slams it into the target. The discharge seizes their nerves, stunning them and stealing their momentum.
data.battleDescription: %user channels concentrated lightning chakra into their fist until it pulses with violent static. With a flash-step and explosive lunge, they slam their electrified strike into %target. The chakra discharges on impact, sending a jolt through the target’s nervous system, locking muscles, distorting balance, and interrupting movement. Thunder Fist is not just a blow; it’s a system shock, leaving %target frozen and open for the next attack.

data.name: Electric Prison
data.description: The user traps the target in an illusory prison of blinding lightning that lashes the space around them. The phantom jolts stun whoever is caught inside, robbing them of action.
data.battleDescription: With a surge of chakra and a flicker of illusion, %user traps %target in a prison of blinding lightning. The phantom bolts lash at their senses, sending jolts of searing pain through their body. Overwhelmed by the crackling current, the target is left stunned as it locks down both body and mind.

data.name: Planetary Devastation
data.description: Using your target as a focal point, you swarm them with rocks crushing them underneath its pressure.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hand together, using %target as the focal point, the earth around them begins to break apart and flying towards %target crushing them under the immense earthen pressure

data.name: Great Vacuum Bullet
data.description: The user takes a deep breath and exhales several small blasts of wind chakra that scatter in different directions, making them very difficult to avoid without injury.
data.battleDescription: %user takes a deep breath and exhales several small blasts of wind chakra that scatter in different directions before converging on %target, making them impossible to dodge.

data.name: Momo3
data.description: The user's horns extend into spears that impale the target and leave them more vulnerable to attack.
data.battleDescription: %user's horns extend and shoot toward %target, impaling them.

data.name: Great Fire Annihilation
data.description: The user creates a blade of fire, the flames of which spread horizontally ahead of them.
data.battleDescription: %user kneads an immense amount of chakra within their body and converts it into fire-natured chakra. Upon release, they expel a colossal torrent of flames from their mouth, shaping it into a vast, ocean-like inferno that spreads across the battlefield.

data.name: Rising Water Slicer
data.description: The user summons a linear wave of water that shoots outward from the ground at high speeds to its target. It is strong enough to slice clean through rock.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a linear wave of water that shoots outward from the ground at high speeds towards %target. It is strong enough to slice clean through rock.

data.name: Stardust
data.description: Calls down star-like dust that empowers the user while leaving the target more vulnerable and burning under later blows.
data.battleDescription: %user performs strange handseals, and with each seal a strange pattern appears on their body. As %user glows, small dust-like particles fall from the heavens, covering the battlefield.

data.name: Void Gaze Rift
data.description: A devastating strike that cuts through both body and spirit.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses their energy, and a dark aura begins to surround them. With a swift and decisive movement, they launch a blade of pure ethereal energy toward %target. This blade cuts through physical defenses like paper, but its true power lies in its ability to sever the connection between body and spirit. %target feels a cold, numbing pain as their very soul is sliced, leaving them disoriented, weakened, and vulnerable to further attacks. The wound left by this strike lingers, disrupting %target's chakra flow and making it difficult to recover.

data.name: Frenzy Assault
data.description: A strong melee attack that unleashes the evolved form.
data.battleDescription: %user taps into their inner rage, muscles surging with adrenaline. Consumed by fury, they unleash a relentless rampage on %target, their attacks fueled by uncontrollable power and ferocity.

data.name: Demonic Vitae
data.description: By tapping into the ancestral demonic energy within their blood, the user can momentarily enhance their physical attributes, increasing their strength and speed for a short duration.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their demonic heritage, their eyes glowing with an eerie light as they draw on the ancient power within their blood. A surge of dark energy pulses through their veins, amplifying their strength and speed. With newfound power, %user launches themselves at the opponent, their movements a blur as they deliver a series of powerful, precise strikes. The opponent is caught off guard by the sudden increase in %user's abilities, struggling to defend against the onslaught. The demonic energy crackles around %user, a testament to their formidable lineage, as they push their limits to gain the upper hand.

data.name: Arcbound Vortex
data.description: The user slams a hand to the earth and a vortex of lightning surges up beneath the chosen spot. Enemies caught in it take lightning damage over the next few rounds and deal less damage while it lasts.
data.battleDescription: %user slams a hand to the ground and a spiraling vortex of lightning tears up through the earth, crackling around every enemy inside.

data.name: Eroding Current
data.description: The user sends a torrent surging up from the ground across an area, battering enemies over the next few rounds. The current wears down their guard, so other attacks hit them harder as well.
data.battleDescription: %user channels water chakra into the ground, summoning a sudden upward torrent across the area. The relentless pressure of the surge breaks the footing of anyone caught in it and erodes their guard, amplifying the impact of future attacks.

data.name: Cyclone Prison
data.description: The user conjures a raging cyclone over an area, trapping enemies in winds that batter them over the next few rounds. Its momentum feeds back into the user, making their attacks hit harder.
data.battleDescription: %user calls down a roaring cyclone across the ground ahead, its gathering momentum surging back into their own strikes.

data.name: Void Pulse Barrage
data.description: A barrage of void pulses erupts from the ground, piercing the enemy and making them take more damage.
data.battleDescription: %user drives void chakra beneath the battlefield and a barrage of pulses erupts upward, tearing through every enemy's guard and leaving them exposed.

data.name: Harmonic Chamber
data.description: Trap your target in a chamber of deadly music.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a great chamber trapping %target inside, while target is busy trying to escape they hear a faint melody turns into a horrifying screech that ruptures %target eardrums leaving them withering in pain.

data.name: Boulder Crush
data.description: A brutal earth strike that smashes the enemy and dulls their offensive strength.
data.battleDescription: %user channels earth chakra into a massive boulder that launches toward %target, crushing them under its sheer weight. The impact disrupts their balance and chakra output, sharply reducing the damage they can inflict afterward.

data.name: Primal Pursuit
data.description: The tiger surges toward its prey and strikes with a ferocious pounce.
data.battleDescription: %user uses Primal Pursuit.

data.name: Healing Foxfire
data.description: Fox ability: Healing Foxfire.
data.battleDescription: %user uses Healing Foxfire on %target.

data.name: Molten Manipulation
data.description: A searing fire technique that burns the enemy and leaves them more vulnerable to all future attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user shapes raw fire chakra into a molten surge that scorches %target on impact. The intense heat lingers, warping their defenses and amplifying incoming damage from any source.

data.name: Stunning Volley
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user shoots a perfectly aimed arrow, finding the weak spot of %target armor stunning them.

data.name: Relentless Guard
data.description: Legion basic defensive stance
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu to mitigate incoming damage

data.name: Parry
data.description:
A precise defensive counter that boosts the user’s bukijutsu damage and reduces the opponent’s offensive output.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user deflects an incoming blow with masterful control, twisting their stance into a sharp counter. The technique shifts the tide of battle—amplifying their own weapon-based attacks while disrupting %target’s ability to strike with full force.

data.name: Celestial Harmony Shield
data.description: Creates a barrier of harmonious sound waves and mystical energy.
data.battleDescription: %user raises their hands gracefully, and a soft, ethereal melody begins to resonate through the air. The sound waves, infused with mystical chakra, form an invisible barrier that shimmers with a faint light. As the melody grows stronger, the barrier solidifies, creating a protective dome around %user. The harmonious vibrations disrupt incoming attacks, dissipating physical blows and nullifying elemental jutsu. The sound waves also have a calming effect, reducing the impact of mental and genjutsu assaults. The shield remains as long as the melody continues, providing %user with a serene, impenetrable defense.

data.name: Death's March
data.description: Release waves of chakra that strikes your target
data.battleDescription: %user envelops %target in a radiant chakra tunnel.  They unleash an unyielding wave of chakra, targeting their enemy's cells with relentless precision. As the assault subsides, the enemy's once-sturdy form crumbles, consumed by decay.

data.name: Lullaby
data.description: Cloud your enemy's sense of hearing and lure them to their death.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a flute from the bones of their body, by imbuing chakra into the flute they begin to play  a harsh melody that slowly erodes %targets eardrums

data.name: Resonance
data.description: Surround yourself with a dust-infused resonance that reflects incoming force and damages the target.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a dust-infused pulse that reverberates around them, reflecting incoming force before striking %target.

data.name: Temporal Erosion
data.description: Rapidly accelerates the target's timeline, causing them to decay and erode into dust.
data.battleDescription: %user extends their hand, pulling particles from the surrounding air that shimmer with an otherworldly glow. The particles coalesce into jagged shards that gleam with distorted time energy. With a swift motion, %user launches the fragments at %target. The shards tear through the air, bending light and warping space as they collide with %target

data.name: Singularity
data.description: A Jutsu that displays the symbolism of the Kyuko-sei. The user manipulates fine dust particles infused with chakra, creating a volatile field that detonates upon command. This technique disperses microscopic shards that pierce targets,
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a powerful gravitational core, tearing into %target and amplifying Dust, Wind, and Earth techniques

data.name: Ethereal Particle Storm
data.description: The user unleashes a storm of charged particles imbued with temporal energy, blanketing the battlefield. These particles create unstable time zones where objects and enemies fluctuate between accelerated and decelerated states, creating chaos and opportunity.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a shimmering cloud of dust particles that engulf %target, eroding their ability to strike effectively.

data.name: summontester
data.description: Fireball like jutsu
data.battleDescription: %user activates sage mode and now has access to all Senjutsu

data.name: Noah_Residual_Test_1
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: Test_Resid

data.name: Noah_Parry_Effect_Test
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu on %target

data.name: Water Style: Water Beast
data.description: The user conjures a beast of churning water that surges forward and slams into the target. A vortex lingers around the user, turning part of the damage they take into health for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a massive beast made entirely of churning water, which surges forward to slam into %target. As it crashes home, a swirling vortex lingers around %user, turning a portion of incoming damage into health. This technique balances offense with a defensive advantage.

data.name: Water Release: Hiding Water Technique
data.description: Launch a surprise attack by hiding in a puddle of water.
data.battleDescription: %user melds into surrounding water, vanishing from sight while preparing for a precise counterattack.

data.name: Tide Release
data.description: Surround yourself in a dome of water rejuvenating your mind and body
data.battleDescription: %user presses their feet to the ground, releasing water nature chakra that envelops them in a dome, the water chakra is filled with healing minerals that  slowly heals the %user wounds

data.name: Earth Release
data.description: Create a mauseleum of stone around yourself
data.battleDescription: %user entombs themselves in a rock formation protecting them from all sides

data.name: Adamantine Fortress
data.description: A defensive earth-style jutsu that raises barriers to protect the user and reduce damage taken.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hand to the ground, channeling earth chakra outward in all directions. Thick stone walls erupt across the field in rapid formation: dense, layered, and reinforced with chakra. These barriers deflect incoming strikes and dull the force of enemy attacks. While active, %user's body is further reinforced by lingering stone chakra, allowing them to absorb more punishment than usual.

data.name: Blast Shield
data.description: Using the concussive blast from an explosion to dampel the next attack you take.
data.battleDescription: %user creatives a massive explosion around themselves neutralizing all attacks coming towards them.

data.name: Small Chakra Barrier
data.description: The user stretches out an arm and raises a small wall of chakra close by. For a short time it stands in the path of incoming attacks, soaking up much of their force.
data.battleDescription: %user performs hand signs and stretches out their arm, creating a barrier of chakra in front of them.

data.name: Cellular Regeneration
data.description: The caster cast a barrier around themselves using time to heal their wounds
data.battleDescription: %user draws sand into a slow, circular flow around their body, forming a protective barrier and healing their injuries

data.name: Summoning: Unholy Harvest
data.description: The user summons and unoly field of pumpkins. Every strike made inside the field burns the striker, and wounds caused will not close.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a portion of the Headless Rider's power, creating an unholy pumpkin patch.

data.name: Cleansing Aura
data.description: A non-elemental jutsu that purges the user of all negative status effects, including residuals and debuffs.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a series of deliberate hand seals, creating a radiant aura of pure chakra that surrounds their body. The cleansing energy washes over %user, dispelling all negative status effects and restoring %user to their optimal state.

data.name: Netherblight
data.description: A corrupting curse that damages the enemy over time while steadily healing the user.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a lingering chakra curse that seeps into %target’s system. As the affliction eats away at them, dark energy flows back to the caster, gradually restoring their vitality with every passing second.

data.name: Crimson Surge
data.description: A punishing chakra strike that damages the enemy and makes their jutsu cost more chakra and stamina.
data.battleDescription: %user launches a surge of volatile chakra that tears into %target’s system. The strike damages them directly and scrambles their inner flow, forcing them to burn more energy when casting jutsu.

data.name: Chakra Siphon
data.description: A jutsu that damages the enemy and makes future jutsu cost less chakra and stamina.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes %target with a spiraling pulse of chakra that draws energy back into their own network. The drain weakens the target while refining the user’s internal flow, allowing upcoming jutsu to be cast with less effort and cost.

data.name: Fireball
data.description: A blazing fireball that deals damage and inflicts burning damage over time.
data.battleDescription: %user forms rapid hand seals and expels a massive sphere of flame from their mouth. The fireball engulfs %target in a wave of searing heat, dealing immediate damage on impact. Flames continue to cling to the target’s body, burning persistently and inflicting additional pain over time.

data.name: Drowning Illusion
data.description: Traps the target in a water illusion, dealing damage and weakening their ability to fight back.
data.battleDescription: The user casts a haunting illusion that submerges %target in a false, inescapable flood. Panic takes hold as phantom waters rise around them, distorting their senses and draining their will to strike back. Every motion feels heavier, every breath more desperate, weakening their ability to launch effective attacks.

data.name: Torrent Shuriken
data.description: A deadly water projectile that deals damage and reduces the users damage taken
data.battleDescription: %user hurls a spinning Torrent Shuriken, slicing into %target with pressurized water while a cascading veil forms around them, dulling incoming strikes.

data.name: Blazing Chains
data.description: Illusionary chains of fire lash onto the target, burning them with searing force before continuing to scorch them over time.
data.battleDescription: The user casts a haunting illusion where spectral chains, wreathed in ethereal fire, burst from the ground and wrap around %target. The fiery bonds sear into their flesh with each movement, warping their senses and igniting phantom pain that continues to ravage their body over time.

data.name: Lunar Descent
data.description: A haunting genjutsu that deals damage and applies damage over time.
data.battleDescription: %user uses their genjutsu to manipulate %target's senses, making them believe the moon is plummeting toward them, overwhelming them with agonizing sensations and terror as they are convinced of an impending catastrophic impact.

data.name: Inferno Dragon's Wrath
data.description: A blazing dragon-shaped assault that deals damage and burns the enemy over time.
data.battleDescription: %user roars with force as a colossal dragon of living fire erupts from their chakra, crashing into %target with scorching fury. The blazing heat continues to cling to the enemy, searing them long after the initial impact.

data.name: Typhoon Tear
data.description: The user unleashes a series of rapid, spinning slashes that create multiple cutting wind blades, shredding through the target and surrounding area.
data.battleDescription: With a fierce cry, %user infuses their blade with swirling wind chakra, creating a vortex of cutting winds. As they slash at %target, the vortex surrounds them, slicing through flesh and leaving behind a lingering effect. %target feels the winds continue to cut at them, causing sustained damage even after the initial strike.

data.name: Blazing Edge
data.description: Fire chakra forms a sword in the user's hand as they surge to a new position and sweep it through nearby enemies. The scorched cuts resist healing for a short while.
data.battleDescription: Flames take the shape of a sword in %user's hand as they surge across the field, carving through nearby enemies in a single searing arc.

data.name: Inferno Leech
data.description: The user lays a writhing curse on the target that bleeds away their health on each of the next few rounds. Meanwhile part of the damage the user takes is turned into health for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user lays a writhing curse on %target that bleeds away their health, while the backlash settles over %user as a veil that drinks in incoming blows.

data.name: Shard Pulse Eruption
data.description: The user detonates a condensed orb of chakra into a spray of shards that rip into the target. The leftover fragments circle the user, briefly guarding their own boosts from being stripped away.
data.battleDescription: %user detonates a condensed orb of chakra, and a volatile spray of shards rips into %target before the fragments swirl back around %user.

data.name: Dragon Breath
data.description: The user breathes a torrent of dragon fire over the target. The flames keep eating at them, dealing further damage over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user exhales a torrent of dragon fire over %target, the searing flames devouring them long after the first blast.

data.name: Savage Blade Cyclone
data.description: The user wraps their blade in a cyclone of wind chakra and slashes the target in a savage spinning cut. The gale keeps howling around the user, making their attacks hit harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user whips their blade through a roaring cyclone of wind, carving into %target as the gale wraps around them.

data.name: Earthquake Fist
data.description: The user smashes an earth-charged fist into the target, rupturing the ground around them. The seismic shock can root every enemy caught in it, leaving them unable to move for a moment.
data.battleDescription: %user slams a fist into %target hard enough to split the ground, the shockwave threatening to root nearby enemies in place.

data.name: Echoing Void
data.description: The user releases a pulse of void chakra that slams into the target. The echo settles over the user, guarding their own buffs from being cleared for a moment.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a wave of void-touched chakra at %target, its echo wrapping around %user to anchor their enhancements in place.

data.name: Eclipsing Gales
data.description: The user whips a wind-charged blade through the target in a single high-speed slash. The cut keeps tearing open, dealing further damage over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user lashes out with a wind-charged slash that rips across %target, leaving a wound that refuses to close.

data.name: En Ken
data.description: The user sets their fists ablaze and pounds the target with a relentless flurry of blows. The flames cling to them afterwards, so the hits that follow burn deeper until the embers die.
data.battleDescription: %user's fists burst into flame as they charge into %target's guard, each blow landing faster and hotter than the last.

data.name: Rock Cleaver
data.description: The user brings down a jagged, earth-laden cleave with crushing weight. The shock rattles the target's footing, so their attacks deal less damage for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user brings a jagged, earth-heavy cleave down on %target, the impact shaking the strength from their arms.

data.name: Rock Fortress Strike
data.description: The user slams a weapon down on the target, and the ground erupts into ramparts of rock. The stone closes around the user like fortress walls, softening the blows they take for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user crashes a weapon into %target as walls of rock burst from the ground and close around %user.

data.name: Swift Combination
data.description: The user unleashes a flurry of rapid strikes that batters the target from every angle. The barrage can scatter their focus, leaving them unable to receive buffs for a brief moment.
data.battleDescription: %user rains a flurry of quick, precise strikes on %target, leaving their chakra too scattered to build any strength.

data.name: Siren's Lament
data.description: The user sings a haunting siren's melody that drags the target beneath a crushing phantom tide. As the song fades, its calm settles over the user, strengthening their healing for a short while.
data.battleDescription: The battlefield is engulfed in a haunting melody as %user's hands dance in graceful, intricate patterns, casting Siren's Lament. %target's eyes widen, captivated by an illusion of a beautiful, yet treacherous, underwater world. Enchanted, they begin to sink into the illusionary depths, their movements sluggish and their breath hitching. Images of ethereal creatures glide by, their eerie calls echoing in %target's mind, luring them further into the depths. As %user completes the jutsu, %target is left gasping for air, shaken by the vividness of the illusion.

data.name: Tempest of the Blade
data.description: The user creates a large, blade-shaped construct of pure wind chakra, which can be wielded as a weapon or launched at the target with tremendous force. The cut leaves the target exposed, so every attack against them hits harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: As %user focuses their chakra, the air around them becomes charged with energy, swirling into a tempest. With a mighty swing, %user unleashes this tempest upon %target, the blade cutting through the air with a deafening roar. The tempest strikes %target with the force of a raging storm, dealing devastating damage.

data.name: Tidal Shift
data.description: The user transforms into surging water, darting across the battlefield to a new position while boosting their offensive power before striking with crushing force.
data.battleDescription: %user harnesses the power of water, their body becoming fluid and untouchable. In a surge of motion, they dissolve into a torrent that sweeps across the battlefield, slipping through the chaos as waves crash in their wake. Reforming in an instant, %user channels the gathered momentum into a devastating, water-imbued strike that greatly enhances their offensive power.

data.name: Blazing Knuckle
data.description: The user sets their fists alight and drives a blazing combination into the target. The fire chakra burrows into their frame, leaving them open to heavier damage from every source in the rounds that follow.
data.battleDescription: %user’s fists ignite with concentrated fire chakra, the heat pulsing with each movement. They launch into a flurry of blazing punches, hammering %target with rapid, explosive force. Each strike forces fire chakra into the target’s frame, loosening muscle control and distorting their ability to brace. The result is lasting vulnerability, and %target becomes far more susceptible to every attack that follows.

data.name: Bonecrusher Kick
data.description: The user whips a crushing kick into the target with bone-cracking force. The blow leaves their body battered, so every attack against them hits harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user charges forward, planting one foot with brutal precision as their leg whips into a wide, crushing arc. The kick slams into %target with raw, unfiltered force, striking deep into the nervous system and chakra flow. The impact causes more than just physical pain; it scrambles coordination and breaks down their defenses. Their guard crumbles under the weight of the blow, so every attack that follows lands harder.

data.name: Chouryū Ken
data.description: The user coils water around their arm and launches a rising uppercut that crashes into the target like a dragon. The force leaves them shaken, so the blows that follow hurt more for a little while.
data.battleDescription: %user crouches low, water coiling around their arm like a living serpent. With a surge of momentum, they launch into a leaping uppercut at %target, water bursting upward in a spiraling torrent. As the punch ascends, it forms the shape of a roaring dragon made entirely of water, propelling %user into the air. The soaked terrain beneath them churns from the pressure, marking the devastating path left behind by the Soaring Dragon Fist.

data.name: Flame Vortex
data.description: The user drives fire chakra into the ground until a spinning column of flame erupts beneath the target. The heat lingers on their body, making every blow that follows burn deeper for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra into the earth, erupting a spinning column of flames beneath %target. The spiraling inferno engulfs them in a brutal surge of heat and force, the flames clinging to them long after the column fades.

data.name: Graveyard of Stone
data.description: The user traps the target in a vision of a vast graveyard where stone hands drag them under and jagged rock rains down. The phantom weight lingers on their mind, so every hit they take strikes deeper for a short while.
data.battleDescription: The user performs a silent sequence of hand seals before slamming a palm to the ground. In an instant, the terrain warps in %target’s vision as they are plunged into a nightmarish realm of collapsing cliffs and shifting tombs. The enemy sees themselves standing in a vast graveyard where every headstone bears their name. Stone hands erupt from the earth, grabbing at their limbs and dragging them downward as the sky rains jagged obsidian boulders. With each phantom impact, real pain blossoms, blurring the line between illusion and reality. The oppressive weight of stone breaks their focus and crushes their will, delivering devastating damage through sheer psychological terror.

data.name: Inferno Kick
data.description: The user sets their leg ablaze and spins into a flaming kick that erupts in searing heat on impact. The flames cling to the wound, burning the target again over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user channels fire chakra into their leg, the limb igniting in a blaze that roars with each step. With a swift leap and a violent spin, they deliver a flaming kick to %target, the impact erupting in a burst of searing heat. The flames cling to the point of contact, continuing to burn and inflict damage over time.

data.name: Mountain Crusher
data.description: The user wraps their fist in earth chakra as heavy as a mountain and drives it into the ground, sending a seismic shock across the area. Any enemy caught in it is rattled, their attacks weakened for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user drives forward with immovable force, earth chakra wrapping around their limb like the weight of a mountain. The strike lands against %target with crushing density, sending a seismic jolt through their frame.

data.name: Phoenix Heart
data.description: The user engulfs the area in an illusory inferno as the cry of a phoenix sears everyone within. The visionary flames refuse to fade, burning them again over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: The user’s chakra flares with ethereal fire as they weave hand signs that blur the line between reality and illusion. %target finds themselves engulfed in a rising inferno of rebirth, their thoughts seared by the haunting cries of a celestial phoenix. As their mental defenses crumble, the phantom flames cling to their mind, searing them again with every breath in the rounds that follow.

data.name: Quaking Fist
data.description: The user stomps forward and hammers a stone-cracking punch into the earth, sending a quake through the area. The tremor shakes everyone it reaches, blunting their attacks over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user anchors their stance, fists brimming with stone-cracking force. With a forward stomp and a devastating punch, they channel tectonic weight into %target’s body, the blow landing like the fall of a mountain. But the damage isn’t just physical. The shock seeps inward, fracturing focus, disrupting chakra flow, and shaking the very core of %target’s will. Their techniques falter, their strikes lose their bite under the pressure, and their power erodes like stone in a quake.

data.name: Rengoku Rō
data.description: The user locks eyes with the target and drags them into an illusory prison of endless flame. The phantom fire keeps smoldering in their mind, so the blows that follow burn deeper for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and channels overwhelming genjutsu energy, summoning a fiery illusion that consumes reality around the victim. Walls of flame twist into phantasmal figures, dragging %target into an endless mental prison of agony and despair. Every sensory input is distorted, disorienting the enemy and leaving their will fractured under the crushing weight of illusionary suffering.

data.name: Rib Breaker
data.description: The user drives a coiled fist into the target's ribs, cracking the channels that carry their chakra. For a short while, every technique the target performs drains far more chakra and stamina.
data.battleDescription: %user drives forward with a tightly coiled strike, targeting the ribs with pinpoint precision. The moment their fist crashes into %target’s side, chakra surges through the blow, fracturing internal flow and rupturing control points. The hit leaves more than bruises; it disrupts how %target channels energy. From that moment on, their chakra and stamina slip through the cracks, making every technique cost more to maintain.

data.name: Shōen Gen'ei
data.description: The user conjures a spiraling mirage of heat that sweeps the field and burns every enemy it touches. The haze stokes the user's own fighting spirit, making their attacks hit harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user vanishes into a mirage of heat and haze, reappearing in flickering bursts as spectral flames race across the battlefield. The illusion strikes everything in its spiral with scorching clarity, searing the mind as much as the body. Each movement sharpens the user's own aggression, amplifying the potency of their next attacks.

data.name: Stone Breaker
data.description: The user drives a stone-weighted weapon down with a crash that breaks over a wide patch of ground. Any enemy caught in the impact is left shaken, their attacks weaker for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user twists mid-air and drives a stone-weighted weapon into %target’s torso with brutal force. The sudden blow reverberates through their body, disrupting their chakra flow and reducing the power behind their next attacks.

data.name: Stormblade Arc
data.description: The user carves a spiraling arc of storm-charged steel that slices through the defenses of every enemy in its path. Lightning coils around the user afterwards, throwing part of the damage they take back at the attacker.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes in a flash, slashing through %target with a blade crackling with storm energy. The momentum whirls the blade onward in a spiral as arcs of electricity coil around their form. The blade’s storm-charged edge reflects part of the incoming damage back toward its source.

data.name: Tempest’s Whisper
data.description: The user murmurs a genjutsu that floods the target's senses with crashing phantom tides. The calm water settles around the user afterwards, turning part of every blow they take into health for a short while.
data.battleDescription: With a mere glance and a faint motion, %user casts a silent genjutsu that invades %target’s senses like a creeping tide. In the illusion, a storm stirs around them, whispers of rain lashing through reality. The target is struck by phantom torrents, while their attacks feel muffled and distant, as if the storm is stealing their force. The user remains within the illusion’s calm eye, the storm turning the blows that reach them into fresh health.

data.name: Tornado Fist
data.description: The user wraps a fist in a condensed cyclone and drives it into the target's core. The torn flesh keeps ripping, dealing further damage over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user spins into action, wind chakra whipping around their arm in a vicious spiral. As they launch their fist forward, a condensed cyclone wraps tightly around the strike. The blow lands with explosive force against %target, tearing at their stance and disrupting their physical core. The turbulence doesn’t fade; it lingers. Wind chakra burrows beneath the skin and into the muscle, tearing at them from within. With the wound left open, %target keeps bleeding long after the blow has landed.

data.name: Volt Fang
data.description: The user sweeps a lightning-cloaked blade in a crackling arc that bites into the ground around the target. The surge flows back up the steel, making the user's attacks hit harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges forward and slashes %target with a blade cloaked in surging lightning chakra. The strike jolts through the enemy in a burst of current that races back up the blade, empowering every attack the user makes.

data.name: Volt Jab Barrage
data.description: The user unleashes a flurry of lightning-charged jabs, each punch jolting the target's nerves. The shocks leave their body raw and exposed, so attacks against them hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user’s fists spark to life as lightning surges through their limbs. In a flash, they close the distance and unleash a relentless barrage of precise jabs, each punch crackling with high-voltage chakra. Every hit sends jolts through %target’s nervous system, overloading muscles, rattling their nerves, and breaking their physical rhythm. As %target’s guard deteriorates, the electricity lingering in their body leaves them open, so every blow that follows lands harder.

data.name: Weary Fists
data.description: The user drives a slow, crushing punch weighed down with dense chakra into the target. The chakra hardens around the user afterwards, turning part of every blow they take into health for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user approaches with grounded steps, chakra coiling around their arm like lead. They drive a deliberate, crushing punch into %target, the force transferring with bone-deep weight. On impact, residual chakra lingers around %user, hardening into a dense field that turns a portion of incoming damage into health.

data.name: Blazing Flash
data.description: Envelops the user in flames to dash across the field with explosive speed and erupt in fire where they land, scorching every enemy caught in the blast. The blaze lingers around the user, making their attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses their chakra, igniting flames that swirl around their body. With a sudden burst of energy, they propel themselves forward at blinding speed, leaving a trail of fire in their wake. The intense heat generated by their movement scorches the ground and air, making their path difficult to follow. As %user moves, the flames around them roar and grow, turning their rapid dashes into fiery streaks that sear anything they touch. The final strike comes when %user reaches their destination, the flames concentrating into a devastating kick or punch that sends a wave of fire bursting across the surrounding ground. The battlefield is left smoldering, with %user standing amidst the remnants of their fiery dash, the flames still roaring around their fists.

data.name: First Chakra Gate
data.description: Unlocks the user's chakra flow, making all of their attacks hit harder while the surging energy dulls the damage they take for a short time.
data.battleDescription: A deep roar echoes from within as %user tears open the first chakra gate. Their aura erupts in a violent surge of energy, rippling through the air like a heatwave. Veins glow beneath their skin as raw chakra floods their network, amplifying every movement and sharpening their control. The ground beneath them fractures under the pressure, and the battlefield trembles as their techniques flare with newfound ferocity, faster, heavier, and more destructive than before, while the surging aura dulls every blow that reaches them.

data.name: Summoning: Lord Pengu
data.description: The people of Hyorin have cohabitated with the Ancient Penguins and have earned the favor of Lord Pengu, who answers the user's call and fights at their side for several rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user pricks their finger and slams their hand to the ground. A cold mist swirls before condensing into a crowned penguin.

data.name: Wind Cutter
data.description: A high-speed wind slash that carves through the area around the target, dealing heavy damage and draining health, chakra and stamina over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user blurs forward in a burst of wind, slashing through %target with razor-sharp wind chakra. The cutting force is so intense it leaves a trail of cleaved air behind, carving across the surrounding ground and draining the strength of all it cuts.

data.name: Inferno Slash
data.description: A fiery slash that deals damage and makes the enemy more vulnerable to future attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user channels blazing fire chakra into their weapon and slashes at %target in a wide arc. The strike erupts on contact, searing through defenses and leaving behind scorching embers that increase the damage the target will take from future attacks.

data.name: Tidal Slice
data.description: The user pivots and sweeps a blade of pressurized water through the target. The surge wraps around the user as it recedes, softening the hits they take for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user pivots swiftly and releases a sweeping arc of reinforced water chakra that tears into %target. As the surge crashes forward, a protective layer of water pressure envelops the user’s body, softening incoming attacks.

data.name: Decapitating Slash
data.description: The user steps in and carves a wide, ruthless arc at the target's neck. The slash leaves them reeling, so every attack against them lands harder until they recover.
data.battleDescription: %user steps in and unleashes a wide, arcing slash at %target, breaking open their guard.

data.name: Flame Crescent Slash
data.description: The user sweeps their blade through a wide arc, releasing a crescent of flame at the target. The fire leaves them scorched, so every hit they take burns hotter for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user channels intense fire chakra into their blade and unleashes a wide, flaming arc aimed directly at %target. The searing crescent tears across the battlefield in a blazing trail, striking with devastating force and leaving a charred path in its wake.

data.name: Wave Cleaver
data.description: The user swings their weapon in a wide arc and releases a cleaving wave of water that crashes over the target and the ground around them. Everything it batters stays soaked and reeling, taking extra damage from every hit for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user swings their weapon in a wide arc, releasing a massive surge of compressed water chakra that rips toward %target. The cutting wave crashes forward like a tidal blade, delivering overwhelming force in a single sweeping motion.

data.name: Brandish Flames
data.description: The user wreathes their sword in fire chakra and cuts a blazing path across the target. The burns keep eating away at their health over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: Fire chakra engulfs %user's blade as they carve a searing arc across %target, leaving burns that keep eating at them.

data.name: Crescent  Reaper Fang
data.description: A high-speed weapon slash that deals massive damage to the target and briefly blocks every attempt to cleanse their ailments.
data.battleDescription: %user grips their weapon with both hands and crouches low before vanishing in a flash of speed. A single arc slices through the air past %target, and for a heartbeat, nothing happens. Then a diagonal wound bursts open across their body, blood spraying as if the strike had been delayed in time. But the real sting comes after: the wound lingers in %target's chakra and refuses every attempt to cleanse it, as if their body is punishing them for moving too soon.

data.name: Rending Slash
data.description: The user carves a deep, ragged slash across the target with a vicious draw of the blade. The wound keeps tearing open, dealing further damage over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user rips a vicious slash across %target, leaving a ragged wound that keeps bleeding.

data.name: Blazing Slash
data.description: The user ignites their weapon with a touch and releases a fiery arc that scorches the target. The searing cut resists healing for a short while.
data.battleDescription: With a quick touch, %user sets their weapon ablaze and descends on %target, releasing a fiery arc that scorches them on contact.

data.name: Suijin Gir
data.description: The user dashes in with a slash of high-pressure water that bursts against the target. The crashing current leaves them off balance, so they take more damage from every source over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user dashes in with a swift slash imbued with high-pressure water, striking %target with explosive force. The slicing current crashes through defenses, leaving the enemy off balance and more susceptible to every follow-up attack.

data.name: Stonebreaker Strike
data.description: The user roots their stance and drives an earth-laden fist through the target hard enough to crack the ground. The shock lingers in their body, so every blow that follows lands harder while the tremor lasts.
data.battleDescription: %user roots themselves to the ground, channeling dense earth chakra through their body and into their strike. With a sudden forward step, they deliver a crushing blow aimed at breaking not just %target, but the terrain itself. The sheer force of the attack sends a deep shockwave through the ground, cracking stone and rupturing the earth beneath their feet.

data.name: Quicksand Trap
data.description: The user casts an illusion of the ground collapsing into churning quicksand that drags down every enemy in the area. Standing calm above the mirage, the user shrugs off part of the damage they take for a short time.
data.battleDescription: The user calmly weaves a deceptive genjutsu, casting the illusion of the ground collapsing beneath the enemy into a churning pit of quicksand. Within the mirage, the sands twist and coil, dragging the target downward as invisible pressure grinds at their body and mind. Their perception of movement slows, their senses dulled by the crushing despair. Meanwhile, the user gains a protective clarity, their awareness sharpened against oncoming attacks. The result is a mirage that defends the caster while eroding the will and health of the target.

data.name: Gaia's Wrath
data.description: The user shapes a massive hammer of earthen chakra and brings it down on the target with the weight of the land. Stone dust settles over the user like a thin crust of armor, slightly softening incoming blows for a brief spell.
data.battleDescription: %user jumps high into the air and draws a long pole. As %user reaches the peak of their jump they start to channel incredible amounts of earthen chakra into the end of the pole to form a huge hammer of natural elements. Mere moments later, %user comes down with the weight of the earth and devastates %target with massive force.

data.name: Veil of Shadows
data.description: The user draws a veil of living shadow across the field, and its formless shapes lash at the target. The veil then settles over the user, turning part of the damage they take into health for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a slow, deliberate seal as an ominous haze spreads through the air, cloaking the battlefield in spectral mist. %target’s vision darkens as they’re pulled into an illusion where formless shadows lash out with invisible strikes. As the veil settles, a portion of every blow aimed at the user loops back to reinforce their health.

data.name: Whirlwind Kick
data.description: The user spins into a gale-driven kick that tears through the target and the air close around them. Wind lingers in their joints and loosens their guard, so all attacks against them hit harder for a short while.

Wind spirals outward in a sharp arc, amplifying the velocity and reach of the strike. When the blow lands, the shock tears through %target’s balance and muscular control. The impact disorients the enemy's defenses, soaking them in reactive chakra that lingers like venom, heightening the damage they suffer from subsequent attacks.
