data.name: Thousand Strike
data.description: The user unleashes a relentless barrage that shatters defenses, leaving the target exposed to further harm.
data.battleDescription: %user descends in a frenzy of strikes, each blow tearing through %target with merciless precision. Defenses collapse under the onslaught, and in the wake of the assault, %target is left wide open, unable to withstand what follows.

data.name: Surfing Strike
data.description: A series of gliding movements atop boiling water
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a torrent of water, flooding the battlefield. Using their Boil affinity, they glide seamlessly over the steaming surface, while the boiling water scalds %target causing %user to take less damage.

data.name: Soul Shackles
data.description: A cursed chakra technique that deals direct damage by tearing through the enemy’s spirit.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures cursed chakra chains and hurls them at %target. Upon contact, the chains pierce through physical defenses and latch onto the target’s spirit, delivering a crushing blow to their core. The pain is sharp and sudden, striking deeper than the flesh and rattling their chakra from within.

data.name: Searing Might
data.description: A blazing chakra technique that hardens the user’s body, reducing incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user channels intense chakra into their core, igniting it into a controlled blaze that spreads through their body. The heat reinforces their muscles and chakra pathways, forming a shield of inner strength. As attacks come in, the energy absorbs and deflects the impact, allowing the user to withstand damage with unshakable resolve.

data.name: Scorch Break
data.description: Your most basic technique as a wielder of the Boil style
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into their palms, turning it into steaming liquid. Dashing forward, %user unleashes a flurry of punches, each strike searing %target's body and leaving burn marks in its wake.

data.name: Sapphire Command
data.description: A complex series of slashes drops your opponent to their knees before you.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a pulse of Blue Blade chakra across the battlefield. As the wave passes through %target, their chakra flow freezes, increasing their vulnerability.

data.name: Holy Magic: Sanctuary of the Crimson Moon
data.description: Manifestation of a vast crimson domain beneath the light of a blood-red moon. A destructive wave of supernatural energy engulfs nearby enemies, inflicting widespread damage while suppressing their offensive power beneath the overwhelming authority of her vampiric magic.
data.battleDescription: A blood-red moon illuminates the battlefield as %user spreads her arms. A massive crimson circle erupts beneath <user>'s, unleashing a devastating wave of scarlet energy. The blast tears through their bodies, spraying blood across the ground as their strength crumbles beneath the crushing pressure of her domain.

data.name: Ring of Spilled Blood
data.description: A spiral of spent blood is thrown across the ground. It opens what stands against the user, and what it opens, it weakens.
data.battleDescription: %user spills a spiral across the ground and it turns outward, hungry. Enemies caught in the ring are opened, and their blows leave the circle duller than they entered.

data.name: Reaper's Embrace
data.description: The user closes in and drains their target directly, tearing vitality from them in a violent, inescapable exchange.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges forward and crashes into %target, dragging %target close as crimson energy surges between them. With every heartbeat, %user rips vitality free, feeding on %target’s life as %user_object holds them through this vicious dance.

data.name: Asmodeus: Embrace of Life and Death
data.description: Invokes the authority of life and death, manifesting a devastating crimson force that tears through her opponent. The vitality stolen through the attack flows back into her body, restoring her wounds as she crosses the battlefield with supernatural grace.
data.battleDescription: %user vanishes in a flash of scarlet light, reappearing beside %target. Her fingers pierce through their defenses as crimson tendrils coil around their body, draining their vitality. Blood sprays across the ground as their stolen life force streams into her wounds, sealing them beneath a sinister crimson glow.

data.name: Poisonous Senbon
data.description: A precise senbon strike laced with venom, designed to weaken the enemy with every hit.
data.battleDescription: %user flicks a handful of senbon with surgical grace, each needle laced with a slow-acting poison. As the senbon strike %target, their body begins to stiffen and falter, chakra flow disrupted by the toxin’s subtle pulse. Though the wounds seem minor, the damage deepens with every breath.

data.name: Inferno Cataclysm
data.description: Unleashes a devastating explosion
data.battleDescription: Battle Description: %user channels the destructive power of their Bakuhatsu bloodline, their body surging with intense heat as the air around them distorts from the sheer energy. With a focused shout, %user slams their hands into the ground, causing the earth to tremble and crack. From the fissures erupts a cataclysmic explosion

data.name: Icebound Might
data.description: The wielder lets winter close over them like a second body. What it grips, it guards, and the cold it sheds sinks into their rival's every limb, dulling their blows before they land.
data.battleDescription: %user plants the trident and the cold closes over %user like armor, plate after plate of pale ice. The chill hangs heavy on every swing at %user, and the blows that land arrive dulled, only settling the frost.

data.name: Ice Shackles
data.description: The Gaze regards a rival and the cold agrees. Frost climbs them like a verdict, and for a breath the world simply declines to let them move.
data.battleDescription: %user levels the trident and its three eyes narrow. Frost races up %target from the ground, locking joint after joint, until %target stands shackled in blue ice.

data.name: Howitzer Crash
data.description: A devastating technique where you propel yourself at the target with an explosion before launching another massive explosion at them.
data.battleDescription: %user explodes the space behind them launching themselves at the opponent then detonates themselves as soon as they get close enough. The explosion weakens the opponent defenses.

data.name: Hemocure
data.description: The user commands their blood to reject injury, sealing wounds and feeding on incoming harm to sustain an unnatural vitality.
data.battleDescription: %user’s blood writhes beneath %user_object skin, surging against the flow of nature. Wounds seal shut as they form, and each strike from %target is devoured, strength stolen as %user refuses to fall.

data.name: Divine Blood: Scarlet Benediction
data.description: Envelop yourself in immortal crimson radiance that absorbs harm, reduces incoming damage, and strengthens your attacks.
data.battleDescription: Crimson radiance surges through %user, forming a blood-forged mantle that absorbs incoming harm, reinforces their defenses, and empowers their attacks.

data.name: Glacial Volley
data.description: The wielder raises the Gaze and the air answers with an arsenal. A dozen lances of ice hang waiting, and every one of them has already chosen where it lands.
data.battleDescription: %user raises the trident and the cold assembles into ranks: lance after lance of pale ice hanging in the air, every point aimed at %target. %user lowers the tines, and winter volleys.

data.name: Ethereal Rebirth
data.description:
A forbidden art that breaks the seal upon the user's soul and burns them anew in green flame, turning every wound into new life at the cost of their strength.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user cracks open the seal upon their own soul, and the elements burn through them in a roar of green flame that erupts outward to strike %target. In the fire's wake %user's body begins to unmake and remake itself, turning every wound they suffer into new life. The rebirth is not gentle; it pulls the strength from %user's arms to feed the blaze, and for a time their blows fall soft as ash. What rises from those flames is harder to kill than what entered them.

data.name: Ethereal Nexus
data.description: A forbidden art that binds fire, water, earth and wind into a knot of chakra that drinks the life of its prey. The hunger it awakens leaves its user's own body exposed.
data.battleDescription: Fire, water, earth and wind spiral together between %user's hands, tightening into a single blinding knot of chakra that burns too bright to look upon. Released, the nexus tears into %target and drinks from the wound, pouring stolen life back into %user with every blow they land. But a power that devours does not rest easily in its host, and as the nexus feeds, %user's own body lies open, stripped raw by the hunger within.

data.name: Drowning Strike
data.description: A fist of boiling water to the face.
data.battleDescription: %user covers their fist in scorching hot water before striking %target in the face, forcing most of that water down their nostrils.

data.name: Decaying Touch
data.description: Touch your target and start to destroy their body through a dusty decay.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a dust cloud that surrounds %target. Dashing through the cloud, they appear in front of %target, placing their hand on them. %target slashes at %user, and their body becomes dust. Only after the dust has disappeared does %target realize that the part of their body that was touched is beginning to decay.

data.name: Death Blessing: Crimson Judgment
data.description: With a cold and merciless gaze, Luminous condemns her opponent through an ancient blood curse. Scarlet energy erupts beneath their feet, inflicting severe damage while disrupting their movements and making every subsequent action more difficult to execute.
data.battleDescription: %user raises two fingers as blood-red sigils ignite beneath %target. Jagged crimson spikes erupt from the ground, impaling their body in a violent burst of scarlet. Blood splatters across the surrounding terrain as a lingering curse shackles their movements, leaving them vulnerable beneath the Vampire Queen's merciless gaze.

data.name: Crimson Tithe
data.description: The user takes a toll in blood and time alike. The shock of the taking locks the victim in place, and what movement remains costs them dearly.
data.battleDescription: %user reaches into the space between heartbeats and takes what is owed. %target staggers, locked mid-motion, and even time itself grows expensive around them.

data.name: Crimson Dominion: Queen's Judgment
data.description: The user compresses vampiric power into a concentrated sphere of crimson energy before releasing it in a devastating blast. The impact overwhelms her opponent's defenses, while the lingering curse weakens their offensive capabilities and allows her to maintain control of the battle.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers a sphere of concentrated crimson energy in her palm before releasing it in a violent explosion. The blast slams into %target, tearing through their defenses as blood scatters across the shattered ground. A dark curse clings to their body while scarlet energy coils around her like a royal mantle.

data.name: Crimson Impact
data.description: The user violently rends their target, leaving them exposed while siphoning vitality from the damage inflicted.
data.battleDescription: %user rends %target with brutal force, tearing open deep, bleeding wounds. The injury lingers, raw and unclosing, as %user drinks from it, each pulse of pain feeding %user’s strength.

data.name: Charge 4 Explosion
data.description: Spreading your chakra across the battle field causes micro-explosions to everything it comes into contact with.
data.battleDescription: %user covers the battlefield with their explosive chakra. Small explosions can be seen and heard happening all around you.

data.name: Azure Dragon Palm
data.description: Land devasting blows from the safety of your dragon.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a water dragon that encases them like armor. Dashing toward %target, each strike they deliver is mirrored by the dragon, landing devastating blows that leave %target battered and overwhelmed.

data.name: Atomic Shield
data.description: Create a barrier of particles that reflects part of the force directed at you and empowers your attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user gathers the surrounding particles into a translucent barrier. Its surface turns part of every incoming impact back on the attacker while concentrating power into %user's strikes.

data.name: Arctic Frost
data.description: Coat your blade in ice chakra and attack your enemy
data.battleDescription: Empowered by Blue Blade Eyes, %user chills the blade in elemental energy, encasing it in ice.

data.name: Fractured Desire
data.description: Creates a burst of alluring shattered crystals that pierce the target and fracture their defenses, leaving them vulnerable to further attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user moves with enchanting fluidity, their steps accompanied by soft whispers of thunder and flickers of lightning that dance around them like sirens’ tendrils. Each graceful motion weaves an electrifying melody before %user releases a burst of alluring, lightning-lit crystals into %target. The fragments pierce their guard and scatter disruptive chakra through their defenses, leaving every follow-up strike more punishing.

data.name: Marrow Eclipse Mantle
data.description: The user mimics Eclipse's desperate survival instinct, hardening their inner skeleton with liquid-black energy. This dense shroud turns part of the damage they suffer into restored health and lends greater force to their attacks.

effects.description: Black marrow knits ruptured flesh shut.
A dim skeletal corona hardens over the user's body.

data.battleDescription: %user hardens their inner skeleton with liquid-black energy, shrouding their body in a marrow-forged mantle. The dense current turns part of each incoming blow into restored health while driving greater force through %user's attacks.

data.name: Water Release
data.description: Surround yourself in a dome of water rejuvenating your mind and body
data.battleDescription: %user presses their feet to the ground, releasing water nature chakra that envelops them in a dome, the water chakra is filled with healing minerals that  slowly heals the %user wounds

data.name: Eight Fist Style: Earthen Grasp
data.description: Eight Fist Style: Earthen Grasp is a taijutsu technique that focuses on immobilizing the opponent. Its earth-charged blows call stone hands from the ground that can root the target in place for a moment.
data.battleDescription: %user channels Earth Release chakra into their fists, delivering a barrage of strikes that causes the ground to erupt. Earthen hands emerge and seize %target's legs. %user finishes with a crushing kick, sending %target to the ground, where the earthen hands may keep them from moving.

data.name: Dragon's Fang (竜の牙)
data.description: Dusk becomes a streak of fire and shadow, delivering a devastating, lightning-fast strike that pierces and stuns the target.
data.battleDescription: %user transforms into a blazing streak of fire and shadow, blitzing through %target with lightning speed. %target barely has time to flinch before crumpling like a poorly trained Genin. Somewhere in the distance, even their clan elders are shaking their heads in disappointment.

data.name: Soulflame Rend (魂焔の裂き)
data.description: Shadowy draconic claws materialize from fiery twilight energy and coil around the user. Embers and shadows sharpen their Water and Wind techniques while forming a draconic mantle that guards them against elemental attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes shadowy claws that coil around their body like a dragon guarding unclaimed ryo. Fiery twilight energy sharpens their Water and Wind techniques while the draconic mantle hardens against elemental attacks. Nice try, though.

data.name: Hiru-Sakura: Sakura-ame
data.description: Infusing chakra into a cloud above their opponent, the user is able to make it rain blossom petals that distort enemy senses.
data.battleDescription: %user infuses their chakra into a cloud above %target, gradually changing the cloud's color to a mix of pink and violet. %user clenches their hand as an immense number of blossom petals begin to fall from the cloud like rain, overwhelming %target's senses.

data.name: Ancient Demon Roar
data.description: The Ancient Demon Roar Jutsu is a powerful and fearsome technique that harnesses the immense chakra of an ancient demon.
data.battleDescription: With a primal roar, %user begins channeling the ancient and powerful chakra within. A massive shockwave, tinged with the aura of ancient spirits, surges towards %target, shaking the very ground and overwhelming everything in its path with raw, unbridled force.

data.name: Petal Nightmare
data.description: A mental tempest of razor-sharp petal blades that fills the target's thoughts with cutting and stabbing pain.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a myriad of razor-sharp petals floating around them, causing %target to hallucinate strange visions and nightmares.

data.name: Thunderclap Barrage
data.description: The user charges their weapon with storm chakra and unleashes a rapid series of crackling strikes on the target. A residual current lingers around the user, softening incoming attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user floods their weapon with storm chakra and rains a rapid series of strikes on %target, the leftover current gathering around them like armor.

data.name: Herald of the Black Night
data.description: A technique that covers the battlefield in a shadowy portal to the world of yokai.
data.battleDescription: %user clasps their hands in a praying motion as a shadowy mist flows from beneath them covering the entire battlefield.

bloodline.name: Night Parade of A Thousand Demons

data.name: Exploding Wood Serpent
data.description: Summon an exploding wooden serpent
data.battleDescription: %user creates a wooden statue, the eyes of the statue starts to glow as a wooden serpent starts wrapping itself around %target then explodes

data.name: Sickle Twist
data.description: Conjures a spectral sickle from dust that disorients and ensnares the target.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their mastery over dust, conjuring a spectral kusarigama from dust in the air, its blade constantly flickering in and out of %target’s vision. The air hums as the weapon twirls back and forth, leaving %target bewildered, their attempts to track it futile. In a blink, the blade solidifies, hurtling towards %target, who braces for impact. Yet, the sickle vanishes once more, only to rematerialize an instant before slicing into %target’s flesh, the chain ensnaring their limbs. With a decisive yank, %user dissipates the weapon, the dust settling ominously into %target’s wounds.

data.name: Dragon Eye Awakening
data.description: Channels celestial energy to enhance both strength and protection.
data.battleDescription: %user steadies their stance as wind currents spiral inward. A vast draconic presence stretches across the skyline while radiant currents descend in measured waves.  Luminous scales of celestial chakra layer across %user’s form, reinforcing muscle and guard alike as their strikes grow heavier and their defense unyielding beneath the crowned horizon.

data.name: Waterborn Shield
data.description: The user cloaks themselves in a dense shell of rolling water. For a short time it soaks up incoming attacks like a second layer of health and dulls the force of every blow.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a Waterborn Shield, wrapping themselves in rolling tides that swallow and dull incoming blows.

data.name: Nature's Curse
data.description: Sap away the life of your target the longer they stand in front of you.
data.battleDescription: %user enters a mad frenzy throwing themselves at %target after a series of furious blows they manage to attach a string of chakra that is naked to the visible eye slowly sapping away the lifeforce of %target

data.name: Liquid Palm
data.description: The user flows to a new position and unleashes rapid water-charged palm strikes on the enemies around them. The current keeps moving through their body afterwards, turning part of every blow they take into health for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user glides forward on a rush of water chakra and crashes into nearby enemies with rapid palm strikes, the current around them ready to drink in the next blow.

data.name: Thunderclap Strike
data.description: The user charges their fists with lightning and lands a strike that bursts with a thunderous boom. The crackling energy surges through their body, sharpening their offense and defense for a short time.
data.battleDescription: Thunder booms as %user drives a lightning-charged fist into %target, the energy crackling back through %user's body.

data.name: Sunshine
data.description: A powerful beacon that brings friendship and hope
data.battleDescription: %user slices his hand and slams his hand on the ground summoning a giant spectral tree that pulses with light giving Kieto a massive boost in chakra.

data.name: Danse Macabre
data.description: The user conjures a bloom of spectral blades that dance around the target before piercing their chakra points. The wounds can seal away their bloodline for a short time.
data.battleDescription: Spectral blades erupt from %user in a ghostly bloom, scattering around %target before arcing inward to pierce the chakra points that feed their bloodline.

data.name: Primal Incineration
data.description: A fierce surge of flame that burns the enemy and makes them more vulnerable to Fire damage.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes Primal Incineration, scorching %target with persistent flames and leaving them vulnerable to further Fire damage.

data.name: Chakra Overflow
data.description: A potent chakra buff that surges through every offensive path, making all of the user's attacks hit far harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user channels a surge of chakra beyond their natural limit, their aura expanding in a volatile ripple of power. This overflowing chakra wraps around them in thick, radiant waves, barely restrained. Chakra Overflow heightens every offensive path: physical strikes land harder, ninjutsu hits with greater force, and even genjutsu becomes more potent. The surge floods through %user's body and mind, doubling down on that force for the intensity of high-stakes combat. It is the edge between control and chaos, a moment where %user becomes a living conduit of power.

data.name: Cool-Blooded Empowerment
data.description: Tapping into your primal chakra, you channel it into your summons, granting them a boost in power.
data.battleDescription: Using the connection they share, %user channels their primal chakra into their summoned allies, granting them a significant boost in strength.

data.name: Shockwave Fist
data.description: The user charges their fist with lightning and releases a crackling shockwave on impact. The surge rattles through the target and stuns them.
data.battleDescription: This technique charges %user’s fists with electrical chakra to deliver a crushing blow. Upon impact, the strike releases a violent surge of electricity that deals damage and stuns %target, leaving them momentarily unable to act.

data.name: Gust Punch
data.description: The user packs wind chakra into their fist and punches the target with a burst of compressed air. The blast cuts straight through their guard, ignoring damage reduction and breaking shields.
data.battleDescription: %user drives a wind-charged fist into %target, and a blast of compressed air bursts straight through their guard.

data.name: Seal of Nullification
data.description: The user binds the target in chains of sealing script that lock their chakra against any new enhancement. The same seals ward the user, shielding them from debuffs for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves intricate seals in the air, summoning glowing ethereal chains that surge toward %target, coiling tightly to disrupt their chakra flow, suppressing any attempts to invoke new enhancements while the last links settle over %user as a ward against debuffs.

data.name: Fan Dance
data.description: The user sweeps a fan through a graceful dance, weaving wind chakra into every turn. Their wind-element attacks strike far harder for a short time afterwards.
data.battleDescription: %user infuses their fan with wind chakra, performing a Fan Dance that amplifies their wind-based abilities.

data.name: Heaven's Blessing
data.description: The user calls chakra down from the sky to settle over the target like a heavy mantle. For a short time they take more damage, and every hit they suffer burns them further.
data.battleDescription: %user draws chakra down from the heavens and lets it fall over %target, leaving them exposed and burning under every blow.

data.name: Blaze Release
data.description: A Flaming lotus that wraps it selfs around the target
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a flicker flaming lotus of With a whispered chant, the lotus blossoms mid-air — and from it burst dozens of petal-like fragments that streak toward %target

data.name: Warpath
data.description: A runeword-charged series of icy slashes that wounds your opponent and strengthens your attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user invokes runewords of iron and strength, empowering themselves before striking %target with cutting ice that leaves a lingering wound.

data.name: Storm Fist
data.description: The user wraps their fist in a spiraling vortex of lightning and drives it into the target. The charge clings to them, so every hit that follows burns deeper for a short time.
data.battleDescription: Lightning spirals up %user's arm as they drive a crackling punch into %target, leaving them sparking with residual charge.

data.name: Divine Thunder Slap
data.description: The user claps their hands until they crackle with lightning, then delivers a thunderous open-palm slap. The charge lingers in their hands, making their next attacks hit harder.
data.battleDescription: Lightning gathers between %user's palms and breaks across %target in one ringing slap, leaving %user crackling with power.

data.name: Fist of 10 ,000 Volts
data.description: The user charges their fists with lightning chakra and hammers the target with crackling blows. The current lingers in their body, sapping their health, chakra and stamina over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user drives lightning-charged fists into %target, each blow sending a jolt through them that keeps draining their strength.

data.name: Infernal Combo
data.description: The user sets their fists ablaze and unleashes a furious combo of punches and kicks on the target. The flames cling to them afterwards, burning them over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: Flames roar along %user's limbs as they batter %target with a blazing chain of punches and kicks, leaving them burning.

data.name: Severed Pulse
data.description: The user slices a wave of chakra through the target's pulse, cutting off the flow that mends their body. For a short while their healing falters and non-elemental attacks strike them harder.
data.battleDescription: %user releases a cutting wave of chakra that severs the natural flow of recovery within %target. The disruption corrodes regenerative functions and breaks down their guard, amplifying the effect of incoming non-elemental attacks.

data.name: Guard
data.description: The user raises a swirling guard of dense chakra that soaks up incoming blows as a temporary shield. For a short time, part of every hit they take is hurled back at the attacker.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves swift hand seals and a spinning wall of chakra rises around them, ready to catch blows and fling them back.

data.name: Ice bound fortitude
data.description: Expand your domain, summoning heavy ice chains
data.battleDescription: %user expands the elemental chakra in wide area, summoning dark ice shackles, binding %target to the ground

data.name: Starlight Veil
data.description: Channels celestial energy to enhance both strength and protection.
data.battleDescription: %user gazes upward, drawing in the shimmering essence of the stars. As the celestial energy courses through their veins, a radiant veil of starlight surrounds them. This ethereal barrier fortifies their defenses, while simultaneously enhancing their offensive prowess. With each attack, %user strikes with the force of a shooting star, and every incoming blow is softened by the veil's protective light.

data.name: Celestial Empowerment
data.description: Channeling celestial knowledge from within, the Celestial Mage becomes fortified with the strength of the constellations of old.
data.battleDescription: %user pours through invisible channels in her veins, threading her bones with quiet radiance and igniting ancient constellation patterns beneath her skin. Her eyes become mirrors of the night sky, deep and burning with distant suns and millions of stars.

data.name: Godflare Construct
data.description: Compiles the first forbidden light into a volatile war-core and detonates it into the rendering layer.
data.battleDescription: %user launches a Godflare Construct at %target, unleashing the first light that ever dared exist—an orb of divine overheat that fractures air, color, and memory with its violent return.

data.name: Chakra Cannon
data.description: A blast of raw chakra to pierce and obliterate your foes
data.battleDescription: %user shapes chakra into a ball in the palm of their hands before throwing it at %target. The chakra explodes dealing damage.

data.name: Eclipse Drain
data.description:
A cursed enhancement that boosts the user's damage and restores health with every strike.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user draws in a slow breath as a shadow-like chakra coils around their arms and chest, pulsing with violent rhythm. Their strikes begin to land harder, the weight of each hit intensified by dark energy. As they attack, part of the damage inflicted siphons back into their body, restoring vitality through every blow.

data.name: Ghosts of the Looking Glass
data.description: Summons ghostly entities from the Vorpal Sword.

effects.description: Ghostly entities emerge from the Vorpal Sword.

data.battleDescription: KyoRuedrig holds out a hilt without a blade, channeling the madness in his heart. Chakra flows down his arm, manifesting the Vorpal Sword into existence. With a single slash of the shimmering blade, KyoRuedrig rends the veil between dreams and reality, allowing the ghost trapped in the Vorpal Sword to break free. The ghostly entities swarm the battlefield, their eerie presence causing %target to feel the chilling grip of madness and despair.

data.name: Crimson Spires
data.description:
A cursed spike technique that makes the enemy take more damage from non-elemental attacks and suffer recoil when they strike.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user conjures blood-red chakra spikes beneath %target’s feet. The moment they pierce upward, they embed a lingering curse that tears at %target's body whenever they attack. Non-elemental damage becomes harder to withstand, and each strike %target makes sends backlash through their own frame.

data.name: Command
data.description: The Primordial Flame is the original essence from which all elemental chakra was born. Unlike ordinary fire, it embodies the perfect balance of the five primordial elements, allowing its wielder to seamlessly channel Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, and Lightning through a single, ever-burning flame
data.battleDescription: Madcrep channels the first flame to blast %target with raw elemental fire, igniting their body and chakra

data.name: Ethereal Bloom
data.description:
A graceful support technique that boosts healing effects and reduces incoming damage.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user blossoms with chakra-infused energy that calms the body and hardens the spirit. As ethereal chakra petals drift around them, healing becomes more effective and damage is softened, shielding them in a veil of resilience.

data.name: Gale Release
data.description: Calls forth a silent and swirling vortex to envelop and confuse.
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into the air, creating a silent cyclone that spirals onto the battlefield

data.name: Ice chains
data.description: Hinder your enermy with ice chains
data.battleDescription: Hinder your enermy with ice chains

data.name: Shimmer
data.description: Synchronizes the user’s chakra with their weapon, enhancing its power.
data.battleDescription: %user channels the power of their lineage into forming a blade dome. As the blade form, their eyes awaken.  In this state, %user 's awareness and abilities are enhanced

data.name: Flash Pulse
data.description: Release a massive pulse of chakra through your body.
data.battleDescription: %user claps their hands together, releasing a massive pulse of chakra around their body.

data.name: Gaze into Yomi
data.description: A forbidden jutsu that brings the target's departed loved ones to the battlefield, crushing them in a cold mist and sealing their bloodline. The user's attacks hit harder for a short time, though every hit they take then burns deeper.
data.battleDescription: %user forms hand seals while smoke rises from their body. The smoke rapidly expands into a cold, damp cloud, engulfing %user and hiding them from sight. %target feels a cold chill run down their back as the area around them turns gray and all color drains from their vision. The mist materializes into spirit-like apparitions resembling deceased family members. They float around %target, softly wailing in agony as they close in, their cold grip crushing the breath from %target and smothering their bloodline while the borrowed grief sharpens %user's strikes and leaves them raw to every blow.

data.name: Martial Movement
data.description: A refined movement technique that evades attacks and reduces the enemy’s offensive power.
data.battleDescription: %user shifts position with disciplined footwork and controlled breathing, weaving through combat with fluid precision. Their movements disrupt %target’s rhythm, dulling the force behind their attacks and reducing the damage they can deliver.

data.name: Forgotten Ember Blade
data.description: Forgotten Ember Blade harnesses the fierce and explosive power of the fire element, once thought lost to the Yaketsuku Netsu bloodline. The user channels their chakra into their weapon, transforming it into a conduit for devastating flames. With a powerful swing, they unleash a wave of fiery energy that incinerates everything in its path, leaving nothing but scorched earth in its wake.
data.battleDescription: %user's eyes burn with an intense focus as they channel their chakra into their weapon, flames crackling to life along the blade. With a powerful shout, they swing their weapon in a wide arc, unleashing a torrent of fiery energy towards %target. The ground beneath the slash ignites, and %target is engulfed in a blazing inferno, their form outlined by the searing flames. The heat is overwhelming, and the sheer force of the attack leaves %target reeling, their defenses crumbling under the relentless assault. The air is thick with the scent of smoke and ash, a testament to the destructive might of the Yaketsuku Netsu bloodline.

data.name: Cosmic CataTism
data.description: The awakened Catboi ascends into full cosmic form, channeling galaxies and meows to bend the battlefield’s fate.
data.battleDescription: %user’s tail stretches into a beam of starlight as their pupils become pure nebulae. They float weightlessly, paws glowing, and the air trembles with soft meows and collapsed timelines. Empowered by their full Catboi form, they radiate cosmic dominance, strengthening themselves and overwhelming their foes with paradoxical force.

data.name: Rei no Kata: Nukitsuke
data.description: The zeroth movement of Tenshin Shoden Yami-Ryu, the mind blade technique is used to conjure up purple blades of bright chakra.
data.battleDescription: Imperial chakra gathers around %user taking the shape of blades. The user takes a neutral stance preparing to attack or defend.

data.name: Celestial Laceration
data.description: Slices the enemy with the power of the stars themselves to balance the scales in favor of the Celestial Mage.
data.battleDescription: %user carves a thin wound in the night itself, and the cut answers her. Silver light lashes outward, slicing through the %target essence as much as their flesh. Their strength spills free in drifting star-motes, torn from the pattern of their fate and drawn into %users waiting grasp. The heavens quietly re-balance the scales.

data.name: Singularity II
data.description: Slash the battlefield’s continuity, leaving the enemy weakened and space untrustworthy.
data.battleDescription: With no warning and even less respect for physics, %user blurs—not forward, but through the idea of space. Their weapon phases mid-swing, trailing streaks of broken light and silent noise. The blade rematerializes mid-laceration, cleaving through %target’s chakra threads like parchment soaked in ink. The wound glows faintly, not with heat, but with wrongness—resistant to healing, resistant to forgetting. As the strike settles, space itself twitches. Ripples spread from %target, bending light, gravity, and momentum. Incoming blows that follow—whether jutsu or pure rage—arrive distorted, their impact muffled, their intent hollowed.

data.name: Planetary Ruin
data.description: Using your target as a focal point, you swarm them with rocks crushing them underneath its pressure.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their hand together, using %target as the focal point, the earth around them begins to break apart and flying towards %target crushing them under the immense earthen pressure

data.name: Abyssal Wraith
data.description: The user conjures wraiths from the abyss that swarm through the target's mind. Their haunting shapes rake at every sense the target has, landing a sharp blow of mental damage.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures the Abyssal Wraith, infusing %target's perception with illusions of malevolent wraiths. The haunting figures induce mental strain, escalating the torment experienced by %target. %user exploits the target's compromised mental state, launching calculated strikes that take advantage of their distracted defenses.

data.name: Hydro Pressure
data.description: The user slams down a dense orb of compressed water that bursts in a high-pressure blast over the area. Every enemy caught takes the hit, while the spray settles around the user to soften incoming blows for a while.
data.battleDescription: %user slams a pulsing orb of compressed water down on %target, the burst flooding outward and leaving a thin current guarding %user.

data.name: Curse Empowerment
data.description: The user absorbs dark energy from cursed tattoos, amplifying their strength.
data.battleDescription: The cursed tattoos etched across %user’s body glow with ominous energy, drawing on the surrounding shadows to fuel their strength. As they attack %target, the dark tendrils of cursed energy lash out, not only delivering pain but channeling that energy back into %user.

data.name: Demons Strike
data.description: Call down a powerful storm strike on an area while raising a temporary shield around yourself.
data.battleDescription: as the storm rages on,  %user calls upon the power of the storm, forming a fearsome lightning strike from within the clouds. The demonic lightning descends with tremendous speed and force, crashing into %target with overwhelming power.

data.name: Storm's Lullaby
data.description: Surrounds an ally with cleansing thunder that removes harmful effects and forms a protective lightning shield.
data.battleDescription: As %user channels their chakra, cleansing thunder rolls around %target, stripping away harmful effects before settling into a crackling protective shield.

data.name: Primate Assimilate
data.description: The user takes on the hardy instincts of a primate, letting their body soak up punishment. For a short time, part of the damage they take is turned into health.

effects.description: Absorb damage taken & convert to health, chakra or stamina

data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, performing the Primate Assimilate jutsu. Through this technique, %user takes on the hardy instincts of a primate, gaining the power to absorb the force of their opponents' attacks and turn it into health. The primal strength rising within %user grows with every blow they endure.

data.name: Founder’s Wrath
data.description: Unleashes a massive attack by harnessing the origins of chakra.
data.battleDescription: Drawing on the very origins of chakra, %user begins to chant an ancient incantation, their voice resonating with the primordial energy of creation. The ground trembles as elemental forces converge around %user—fire, water, earth, and lightning swirl into a tempest of raw power. With a final, commanding gesture, %user unleashes this elemental fury upon %target. The combined elements strike with devastating force, engulfing %target in a catastrophic storm that obliterates everything in its path. The sheer magnitude of the attack showcases the true power of the Heavenly Founder's legacy.

data.name: Breeze Guardian Shield
data.description: Summon a protective wall of wind and dust
data.battleDescription: Using a series of hand seals %user crafts a formidable wall of swirling wind and dust. As %user stands behind the wall, they are protected from harm, deflecting incoming attacks and reflecting damage back at the attacker.

data.name: Kaze Kama
data.description: The user shapes compressed wind into a curved blade and sends it slicing into the target. The wind keeps circling the user afterwards, letting them heal from part of the damage they deal for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures a crescent blade of wind and flings it at %target, the gusts curling back to mend %user with each blow that follows.

data.name: Stone of the Withering
data.description: The user hurls a withered shard of compacted earth that cracks against the target. The shard's hunger passes into the user, letting their attacks draw back health for a time.
data.battleDescription: %user hurls a cursed shard of compacted earth chakra at %target. The impact disrupts their vitality and awakens a latent siphoning effect within the caster, allowing them to absorb health from their next damaging attacks.

data.name: Aqua Barrier
data.description: A protective water shield that boosts attack and defense.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a swirling barrier of water, dampening incoming attacks while empowering their own strikes.

data.name: Riptide Kick
data.description: The user spins a vortex of water around their leg and drives it into the target like a riptide. The current then lingers around them, converting some of the damage they take back into health for a short while.
data.battleDescription: Water swirls around %user's leg as they leap and crash a riptide kick into %target, the current curling back to cloak them.

data.name: Skyfang Burst
data.description: Unleashes a massive attack by harnessing the origins of chakra.
data.battleDescription: %user bursts forward in a controlled surge of movement, slipping along an unexpected angle before driving a reinforced strike through %target’s guard.  Draconic pressure concentrates at the point of contact, piercing their defenses as %user flows past them in the same motion. Luminous scales of condensed chakra form along %user’s frame, fortifying their defense as they reposition to superior ground.

data.name: Aqua Fist
data.description: Forms hardened water around the fists for devastating punches. Afterwards the water flows back over the user, strengthening their healing for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user's fists, surrounded by swirling, hardened water, unleash a barrage of punches at %target, each strike hitting with the force of crashing waves, before the water flows back over %user and strengthens their healing.

data.name: San no Kata: Yasakani
data.description: The hidden third movement of Tenshin Shoden Yami-Ryu, it is the awakening of the most basic principle taught in school: Mediation.
data.battleDescription: With senses honed and heightened to their peak, %user is able to enter a deep meditative state, their purple chakra flowing from their body freely, bolstering their defense. Then, before anyone can react, an unblockable slash rends across %target

data.name: Heavenly Barrier
data.description: Form draconic chakra constructs to pierce your opponent’s defenses and reduce incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a mantle of draconic chakra before striking %target with concentrated celestial force that pierces their defenses. The mantle remains around %user, reducing incoming damage.

data.name: Chakra Enfeeblement
data.description: The user forms a quick sequence of seals and drives refined chakra into the target's system, unraveling its flow. For a short time they take heavier damage and their own attacks lose force.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a brief sequence of hand seals, projecting a wave of refined chakra directly into %target’s system. The energy latches onto their internal flow, destabilizing it with precision. Defensive chakra pathways collapse under the interference, causing %target’s body to react poorly to incoming attacks. Their guard weakens, and every hit taken from that point forward lands harder than before, while their own attacks lose force.

data.name: Storm Dragons Halo
data.description: A  devastating strike that cuts through both body and spirit.
data.battleDescription: %user steps in with disciplined precision and drives a chakra-infused strike into %target.  At the moment of impact, a radiant draconic sigil flashes between them, tracing the structure of %target’s active enhancements. Celestial currents rise and mirror that power before descending into %user, manifesting the same amplified force within their aura.

data.name: Star Realignment
data.description: Using long since forgotten constellations, the Celestial Mage binds their enemy in the radiant force and rewrites the fate of the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user traces a shattered constellation in the air, forcing %target’s fate into the path the heavens intended. Starlight snaps into place around them like invisible chains. Their strength falters, their magic stutters, and their destiny is rewritten mid-breath followed by a cold surge of astral force that tears through body and spirit alike.

data.name: Lightning Flash Step
data.description: The user flashes to a new position in a burst of lightning, unleashing strikes that pierce any guard across the area around their landing point. The shocks linger, hurting anyone struck again over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user surrounds themselves with lightning chakra, flashing to a new position at blinding speed and delivering rapid, precise strikes from all angles that tear through any guard.

data.name: Strike: Raijin
data.description: The culmination of your Bloodline limit, you create thunderclouds above the battlefield that rain down lightning indiscriminately, destroying everything.
data.battleDescription: %user summons up thunderclouds in the sky, charging their body with chakra, they disappear from the field of battle and strike down from the heavens on %target

data.name: Stormguard Aura
data.description: A defensive technique that envelops the user in a protective aura of electricity, deflecting attacks and boosting their resistance to damage.
data.battleDescription: %user creates a shimmering Stormguard Aura of crackling electricity, dispersing incoming attacks while enhancing their resilience, allowing them to endure prolonged combat with unwavering strength.

data.name: Phantom Requiem
data.description: The user calls up a ghostly mist that strikes the target and seeps into their body. Over the next few rounds it bleeds away their health, chakra and stamina.
data.battleDescription: %user forms a seal, summoning a ghostly mist that seeps into %target’s body. Wisps of blue and red energy, chakra and stamina along with their very life, are ripped from them, spiraling away into the mist. %target’s limbs grow heavy, their strength fading as exhaustion takes hold. If they don’t break free, they’ll collapse under the relentless drain.

data.name: Star Guardians
data.description: Called down from the stars above, Star Guardians protect their Celestial Mage while reflecting attacks back to the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user lifts her gaze to the fractured heavens, and the dying star in her chest answers with a silent pulse. From the night spill living constellations, tall figures forged of cold starlight, bound by forgotten orbits. They strike at %target with radiant force, and when blades or spells fall upon them, the light bends, turns, and returns the violence to its source.

data.name: Grand Fire Annihilation
data.description: The user creates a blade of fire, the flames of which spread horizontally ahead of them.
data.battleDescription: %user kneads an immense amount of chakra within their body and converts it into fire-natured chakra. Upon release, they expel a colossal torrent of flames from their mouth, shaping it into a vast, ocean-like inferno that spreads across the battlefield.

data.name: Swallow's Flight Slice
data.description: A swift closing slash that restores the user's health from the damage it deals.
data.battleDescription: Closing the gap with the speed and relentlessness of a demon, %user draws their bokken and strikes with the force of a hundred men.

data.name: Riptide Reaper
data.description: The user sweeps a reaping arc of riptide water across the field, tearing through every enemy caught in the spiral. The current flows back into the user, letting their attacks drink health from every wound they deal for a time.
data.battleDescription: %user swings through a spiraling riptide that drags across the battlefield, the dark water flowing back to feed %user.

data.name: Crushing Tides
data.description: The user unleashes surging waves of boiling water that flood an area and scald every enemy caught over the next few rounds. The rising steam fuels the user's own attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes surging tides of boiling water that crash over %target and keep scalding everything in their path.

data.name: Lightning Surge
data.description: The user sends a surge of crackling electricity coursing into the target. The current keeps jolting through their body and can stun them over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user channels a surge of crackling electricity into %target, leaving their muscles locked and twitching.

data.name: Dark World
data.description: A forbidden jutsu that releases the shadows of the underworld on the target, piercing them with black lightning and leaving them open to heavier damage. For a short while the user feeds on the blows they land, though the darkness leaves them burning under every hit.
data.battleDescription: %user forces chakra through their body until it pours out into their shadow. The chakra mixes with their shadow, which grows and absorbs every bit of shadow in the vicinity. As the shadow spreads around %target it also expands, covering the surrounding area in complete darkness. The moment the jutsu hits, it locks %target in a dome of darkness where black razor spikes crackling with lightning jut from the ground and retract, stabbing %target and leaving them exposed to every blow to come. The darkness seeps back into %user, feeding on the blows they land while leaving them burning under every hit they take.

data.name: Tamashī no Sakeme
data.description: A devastating strike that cuts through both body and spirit.
data.battleDescription: %user focuses their energy, and a dark aura begins to surround them. With a swift and decisive movement, they launch a blade of pure ethereal energy toward %target. This blade cuts through physical defenses like paper, but its true power lies in its ability to sever the connection between body and spirit. %target feels a cold, numbing pain as their very soul is sliced, leaving them disoriented, weakened, and vulnerable to further attacks. The wound left by this strike lingers, disrupting %target's chakra flow and making it difficult to recover.

data.name: Celestial Sealing
data.description: Seals the enemy's bloodline abilities.
data.battleDescription: %user's eyes glow with an ancient, divine energy, focusing intently on %target. With a series of intricate hand seals, they channel this energy into a binding force that surges towards %target. The celestial light surrounds %target, forming luminous chains that bind their body and spirit. These chains pulse with divine energy, penetrating deep into %target's chakra system. As %target struggles, %user completes the sealing technique, locking away %target's bloodline abilities. The celestial chains tighten, sealing %target's bloodline and rendering their unique abilities inert, leaving them vulnerable and powerless.

data.name: Tidal Crash
data.description: Uses water-enhanced strikes to overwhelm the target, the surge spilling outward over the surrounding ground.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into the water, amplifying their strength to unleash a series of powerful, wave-infused blows that batter %target, leaving them soaked as the surge spills across the surrounding ground.

data.name: Tides of Despair
data.description: The user drowns every enemy in the area under a sorrowful tide of illusion. The ebbing waters wash back over the user, steadying their mind so the blows they take land softer as the tide recedes.
data.battleDescription: Waves of illusion crash down upon %target, carrying with them the weight of despair and failure. The enemy becomes overwhelmed by visions of loss and futility, their thoughts dulled by a mind too heavy to focus. The user's chakra synchronizes with the flow, reinforcing their mental defenses against incoming assaults.

data.name: Gale Force Blast
data.description: The user compresses wind chakra into a narrow, drilling stream that bores straight through the target's guard. The blast leaves them torn open, taking more damage from every attack for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user compresses a violent burst of wind chakra into a narrow stream and launches it toward %target. The blast drills through defenses, disrupting their chakra flow and making them more vulnerable to all incoming attacks.

data.name: Surging Water Slicer
data.description: The user summons a linear wave of water that shoots outward from the ground at high speeds to its target. It is strong enough to slice clean through rock.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a linear wave of water that shoots outward from the ground at high speeds towards %target. It is strong enough to slice clean through rock.

data.name: Tempest of Shadows
data.description: The user twists light and shadow into a whirling storm of illusory blades that pierce the target's guard. The phantom cuts linger, leaving them open to harder hits from every attack in the rounds ahead.
data.battleDescription: With a silent breath, %user extends their hand, distorting the light and shadows around them into a whirling maelstrom of razor-sharp illusions. The air tears open before %target as spectral blades howl through the storm, piercing mind and body alike. Every cut amplifies the target’s susceptibility to harm, warping their perception and weakening their defenses. The storm does not relent; it lingers in the mind, turning every blow that follows into inescapable torment.

data.name: Windslicer Roundhouse
data.description: The user whips into a roundhouse kick wrapped in wind chakra, and the leg trails a slicing gust. The crescent of air cuts into the target with the full force of the blow.
data.battleDescription: %user's leg arcs through the air, trailing a razor-edged crescent of wind that slices across %target.

data.name: Rensa Kaminari
data.description: The user releases a chain of lightning that leaps between every enemy in the blast. Stray current wraps around the user afterwards, softening the blows they take until the current fades.
data.battleDescription: %user hurls a chain of lightning at %target, the bolts leaping from enemy to enemy before the spare current coils around %user.

data.name: Chakra Ignition Strike
data.description: The user flares their chakra and crashes a wave of violent pressure over the target, breaking their guard. For a short time the target takes more damage while the user's body hardens against blows.
data.battleDescription: %user's aura flares with dense chakra that crashes over %target and shatters their guard, while %user's own body hardens behind it.

data.name: Celestial Bind
data.description: Seals the enemy's bloodline abilities.
data.battleDescription: %user’s gaze fixes on %target as a blazing dragon sigil ignites above. With a decisive forward motion, celestial force descends in a concentrated pillar, crashing into %target with overwhelming authority.  Draconic chains of light bind their chakra pathways, sealing their bloodline’s power as suppressed energy rises and funnels into %user, amplifying their strikes with sovereign force.

data.name: Stone Dance Slash
data.description: The user dances forward and whips a weapon heavy with earth chakra across the target. The grinding stone leaves them battered, so the blows that follow hit harder over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user channels seismic chakra into their weapon and dashes toward %target, unleashing a spiraling slash infused with the force of crumbling mountains. A vortex of rotating stones surrounds the user, whirling with the blade and amplifying the power of the strike. The impact sends jagged rock fragments flying, shaking the ground beneath and leaving a cracked, ruptured battlefield in its wake.

data.name: Voltari
data.description: Calls lightning down onto a target area and channels the charge to empower the user's earth, lightning and water techniques.
data.battleDescription: %user summons lightning from the heavens, drawing it down upon %target's body and containing the current within and around their form. Electricity crackles violently across %target's body.

data.name: Stellar Inferno
data.description: Invoke a celestial inferno that engulfs the battlefield in scorching radiance. Blinding light and intense scorch chakra devastate the area, leaving lasting destruction.
data.battleDescription: %user calls upon the sun’s full power, evaporating the air around %target. As scorched oxygen enters their body, it dehydrates them from within, leaving them gasping and burning.

data.name: Echoing Rift
data.description:
The user tears a spectral rift into the target's chakra, turning part of every blow they land back on them, and it can stun them. Holding the rift open costs the user, who burns deeper under every hit for a short time.

DON'T TRAIN. ALREADY CAPPED. IT HAS NO POWER PER LEVEL
data.battleDescription: %user lashes a spectral rift into %target's chakra, and a resonant hum sets every move they make echoing back against them.

data.name: Flame Burst Punch
data.description: The user ignites their fist with fire chakra and drives home a punch that bursts into flame on impact. The fire keeps eating at the target afterwards, dealing heavy burn damage over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: Flames roar up %user's arm as their fist crashes into %target, the blast leaving fire that clings and keeps burning.

data.name: Celestial Rend
data.description: Using the power of dying stars, the Celestial Mage channels the heavens above to strike down the opponent.
data.battleDescription: %user raises her hand and the dying star in her chest flares like a broken heartbeat. The constellations above twist out of alignment as she tears a seam through the fabric of the sky itself. A blade of compressed starlight descends, silent and absolute, slicing through %Target's body and destiny alike.

data.name: Thunderbolt Fusillade
data.description: Summons a barrage of lightning bolts at the target while surrounding the user with a current that wards off harmful effects for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a relentless storm of thunderbolts at %target as a protective current surrounds %user, repelling harmful effects.

data.name: Whirlpool Grapple
data.description: The user spins a whirlpool around the target and grapples them in its pull. The churning water saps their strength, weakening their combat stats for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user drags %target into a churning whirlpool and wrestles them through its current, the water sapping their strength.

data.name: Warden's Zephyr
data.description: A slicing wind jutsu that strikes the enemy and surrounds the user in a protective barrier of air.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a sharp gust of compressed wind that slams into %target with cutting force. As the wave disperses, the wind coils back toward the caster, forming a swirling shield of chakra-infused air.

data.name: Heavenly Constructs
data.description: Creates chakra constructs for massive damage and defense.
data.battleDescription: %user's hands move with fluid grace, channeling their chakra into pure, radiant energy. This energy takes form as shimmering constructs—spectral weapons, towering shields, and fierce guardian beasts. The battlefield is transformed into a scene of divine warfare, as these constructs move to both attack and protect. %target finds themselves besieged by a relentless barrage of ethereal blades and spectral beasts, each strike imbued with the raw power of %user's chakra. Simultaneously, %user is enveloped in a fortress of light, the constructs forming an impenetrable defense that deflects any incoming attacks.

data.name: Purifying Wave
data.description: The user sends a crashing wave of clear water chakra into the target. The spray settles around the user as a protective film, blunting incoming damage for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user calls up a crashing wave that slams into %target before folding back to wrap %user in a shimmering guard.

data.name: Reapers Storm
data.description: This jutsu unleashes a devastating lightning strike in the form of a demon that crashes through the clouds and slams into the target with immense force
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra, summoning a torrent of water that cascades onto the battlefield in a tidal wave. The surging water drenches the area, leaving the opponent caught in the flow. With a crackling charge, %user infuses the water with lightning chakra, causing the terrain to spark and sizzle with electric energy

data.name: Flash Kick
data.description: The user flashes across the field and lands in a storm of lightning-charged kicks. Every enemy around the landing spot is caught in the crackling flurry.
data.battleDescription: %user explodes forward in a storm of lightning-charged kicks, each strike cracking with blinding speed and power. The final roundhouse erupts in a flash of electricity, scattering a haze of sparks across the ground where %user lands.

data.name: Lux
data.description: An orb of light that explodes upon impact.
data.battleDescription: %user creates an orb in the palm of one hand. Within the orb, small lights of multiple colors begin to form. As the orb grows, the lights brighten until four translucent rings appear around it. In an instant, %user appears in front of %target and strikes them in the chest with the orb. Upon impact, the orb explodes, and the translucent rings begin to tear %target apart.

data.name: Marshmallow Blitz Bomb
data.description: Teni pulls out a bag of marshmallows from her pocket and tears it open with her teeth. Tossing them into the air, they rain down on the opponent, with each explosion feeling larger than the last. The opponent is covered in sweet, melted marshmallow goo which burns and damages them.
data.battleDescription: With a wild grin, %user tears open a bag of marshmallows and tosses them skyward. As they rain down, each marshmallow detonates in a fiery explosion, covering the %target in molten, sticky goo. The goo burns fiercely, causing intense damage and leaving the opponent immobilized and scorched.

data.name: Stone Skipping
data.description: The user skims chakra-weighted stones low across the ground so they bounce into the target in quick succession. The battering leaves them off balance, so the blows that follow land harder for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user channels chakra into a handful of flat stones, enhancing their mass and speed. With a precise flick of the wrist, the stones launch forward, skipping across the ground and striking %target with successive, chakra-infused impacts. Each bounce amplifies the force, turning a simple motion into a relentless barrage.

data.name: Tectonic Stomp
data.description: The user stamps the ground to raise a wall of stone behind the target, then smashes them through it. The impact rattles them, softening their attacks over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user stamps the earth to throw up a stone wall behind %target, then sends them crashing through it with a crushing blow.

data.name: Boulder Barrage
data.description: The user tears massive boulders from the earth and hurls them at the target in a crushing barrage. The leftover stone gathers around the user as a shield that soaks up blows for a brief spell.
data.battleDescription: %user rips a series of boulders from the ground and hurls them at %target, keeping the last of the stone close as a shield.

data.name: Stone Hammer Kick
data.description: The user brings a stone-hard heel down like a falling slab, sending a shockwave through every enemy in the area. Shards of hardened chakra cling to the user afterwards, dulling the blows they take for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user reinforces their leg with dense earth chakra, then launches into a spinning downward kick that slams into %target like a falling slab of stone. Upon impact, shockwaves ripple through the ground, and fragments of hardened chakra recoil around %user’s body. These chakra shards linger like a shell, bracing against impact and dulling incoming attacks.

data.name: Quicksand Mirages
data.description: The user bends the target's mind until the ground seems to swallow them, the illusion striking at their senses. Panic grips them as they sink, weakening their attacks for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user bends the mind of %target and creates an illusion of them sinking into quicksand. The feeling is real as their body sinks into the sand, and they can feel it getting stuck under the pressure as they fall into a state of panic.

data.name: Earth Style: Shattering Kick
data.description: The user plants their weight and drives an earth-charged kick upward into the target. The ground cracks beneath their heel as the blow lands with crushing force.
data.battleDescription: %user drops low and plants their weight before delivering a crushing upward kick infused with earth chakra. The ground beneath their foot cracks as force surges through the strike, slamming into %target with seismic impact. In an instant, %user propels themselves forward with the force of a tempest, moving at a speed that seems almost impossible. The wind roars in their wake, creating a vortex that tears at the surroundings. As %user completes their dash, they reappear in a new position, ready to strike or evade further assaults, while chaotic winds burst outward to slash at everything around their landing spot.

data.name: Rock Barrage
data.description: The user tears jagged stones from the ground and hurls them in a hail at the target. The rocks shatter on impact, battering every enemy caught around them.
data.battleDescription: %user slams their weapon into the ground, channeling chakra to tear the earth apart beneath them. With a precise swing, they command jagged chunks of stone to rise and fly forward like deadly missiles. The barrage of sharpened rocks strikes the battlefield in a brutal, calculated rhythm, dealing heavy earth-based damage.

data.name: Phantom Step
data.description: The user flits across the field like a phantom, landing in near silence. Allies around the landing spot take less damage for a short time, while the user's own attacks hit harder.
data.battleDescription: In the midst of combat, %user channels their chakra into their legs and feet, synchronizing their movements with the surrounding shadows. With a light step, they become nearly invisible to the naked eye, their presence fading like a phantom. The user moves silently and swiftly, weaving through obstacles without making a sound. As %user advances, their form flickers in and out of visibility, making their movements difficult to track. By the time anyone pinpoints %user's position, it's already too late; %user is poised for a counterstrike, and the lingering shadows guard them from harm.

data.name: Pill Pack: Large Health Pill
data.description: The user swallows a large red pill packed with healing herbs. Its medicine mends their wounds over the next few rounds and leaves their attacks hitting harder.
data.battleDescription: %user swallows a large red pill, and warmth spreads through their body as their wounds begin to knit.

data.name: Pill Pack: Chakra Pill III
data.description: The user bites into a pill pressed from ancient ginseng and floods their body with its stored chakra. For a short time, every technique they use strikes with far greater force.
data.battleDescription: %user bites down on the pill, and a rush of stored chakra surges through their body, lending every strike a sudden, fearsome power.

data.name: Life Release: Spirit Wall
data.description: A forbidden technique that converts the user's life force into a massive chakra barrier able to withstand devastating attacks. Though immensely powerful, it exacts a heavy toll on the user's health.
data.battleDescription: %user sacrifices their life force as crimson chakra erupts around them, forming a massive chakra barrier covered in glowing sigils. The blood-forged wall withstands incoming attacks while waves of violent chakra surge from %user’s body.

data.name: Feint Step
data.description: Granted by a worn charm, this perfect feint carries the user across the field between heartbeats, leaving only an afterimage. For a moment afterwards, their actions cost them less effort.
data.battleDescription: %user vanishes in a smear of afterimages and reappears across the field before anyone can react.

data.name: Anchor the Storm
data.description: The user drives the Stormanchor's grounding current into the earth, and no one standing in the circle can be struck down for a moment. Allies within it also turn part of the damage they take into health for a short while.

effects.description: Anchored ground shelters all within from the storm's killing blow
A dome of grounded pale light

data.battleDescription: %user drives the Stormanchor's current into the ground, and for one breath nothing can kill those anchored beside them.

data.name: Wind Release: Mighty Gust
data.description: The user hurls a mighty gust that tears at the target's guard and leaves them reeling. For a short time, wind attacks cut into them more deeply.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a howling gust at %target, stripping away their footing and leaving them open to the wind.

data.name: Summoning: Titanoboa
data.description: The user cuts their palm and presses the blood to the earth, calling the great Titanoboa onto the field. The giant serpent fights at their side for several rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user slices their palm on a kunai and slams it to the ground, and the vast coils of the Titanoboa rise from the earth.

data.name: Spectral Counter
data.description: The user wraps the target in an illusion of spectral foes poised to counter every move. Unnerved, they leave openings everywhere, taking more damage from all attacks for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user conjures spectral duellists around %target, unsettling their guard and leaving them open to every strike.

data.name: Solar Flare Kick
data.description: Harnesses fire chakra to execute a dazzling kick that emits blinding light upon impact.
data.battleDescription: %user delivers a blazing kick that bursts into blinding light as it slams into %target.

data.name: Liver Shot
data.description: Taijutsu that deals damage and increases damage taken by the enemy.
data.battleDescription: %user drops low and drives a sudden hook into %target's side, folding them around the blow.

data.name: Liquid Thrashing
data.description: The user unleashes a thrashing torrent of water that batters the target again and again. The water then wraps around the user, turning part of every blow they take into health for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user summons jagged, thrashing tendrils of water to strike %target repeatedly, then draws the torrent around themselves as a protective veil that absorbs incoming damage.

data.name: Glyph Blade
data.description: A precise bukijutsu slash that deals damage and reduces the enemy's damage output.
data.battleDescription: %user slashes %target with a glyph-etched blade, leaving a glowing seal that saps the strength from their attacks.

data.name: Fire Release: Burning Soil
data.description: The user sets the ground ablaze beneath the target and blasts them with searing heat. The flames then rise around the user as a ward, softening the blows they take for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user scorches the earth under %target in a burst of heat, then draws the rising flames around themselves as a guard.

data.name: Clone Technique
data.description: The user shapes chakra into a perfect copy of themselves on a nearby tile. The clone shares their full strength and fights on its own for a short while before it fades.
data.battleDescription: %user splits apart in a burst of chakra, and an identical clone steps out onto the field ready to fight.

data.name: Chakra Barrier
data.description: Hardens the body with chakra to reduce damage taken.
data.battleDescription: %user spreads a faint, shimmering layer of chakra across their body to soften the coming blows.

data.name: Tornado Vortex
data.description: The user whips up a raging tornado that tears across an area and batters every enemy inside. The cutting winds leave ragged wounds that keep bleeding over the next few rounds.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a howling tornado that engulfs %target and the ground around them, flinging everyone caught inside back to earth.

data.name: Shattering Strike
data.description: The user brings down a shattering blow that cracks against the target with full force. The impact braces the user's stance, softening the hits they take until the tremor fades.
data.battleDescription: %user brings down a shattering blow on %target, planting their feet firm as the shock rolls through the ground.

data.name: Rejuvenating Chakra
data.description: The user turns their chakra inward and guides it through the body's pressure points. Their wounds begin to knit, restoring a good measure of health as the next round begins.
data.battleDescription: %user closes their eyes and draws chakra inward, a soft glow gathering over their wounds as they start to close.

data.name: Gale Dance
data.description: The user whirls through a graceful dance of wind-wrapped strikes that cut into the target. The rending gusts leave them off balance, so they take more damage from every source for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user spins through a flowing dance of wind, each graceful strike slicing into %target and leaving them exposed.

data.name: Faint Shadow
data.description: The user casts an illusion of whispers from every direction, unsettling the target and battering their mind. Their growing paranoia emboldens the user, whose attacks hit harder for a short time.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves a web of whispering illusions around %target, the faint voices tearing at their nerves while %user's confidence swells.

data.name: Eternal Darkness
data.description: The user shrouds the target in a veil of darkness, blinding them so their attacks lose force. Hidden in the gloom, the user also takes less damage for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user weaves a string of hand seals, and a veil of darkness swallows %target, hiding %user from their sight.

data.name: Earth Release: Earthquake
data.description: The user stamps hard and sends a shockwave of splitting earth racing towards the target. The tremor surges back up through their legs, strengthening their taijutsu and bukijutsu in the moments after.
data.battleDescription: %user stamps the ground and sends fissures racing towards %target, the tremor rising back up to steel %user's limbs.

data.name: Crimson Vein
data.description: The user lashes crimson threads of chakra into the target, opening their body so later hits land harder. The threads also link back to the user, letting their attacks draw life for a short while.
data.battleDescription: Crimson threads lash out from %user and burrow into %target, laying them open and tying every strike %user makes to a thread of stolen life.

data.name: Crescent Strike
data.description: The user darts to a chosen spot and sweeps their blade in a wide arc shaped like the crescent moon. The cut strikes every enemy around them as they land.
data.battleDescription: %user flashes across the field and lands in a sweeping crescent slash that cuts through the enemies around them.

data.name: Chakra Palm
data.description: The user packs raw chakra into an open palm and drives it into the target. The released energy rebounds around the user as a protective shield for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user drives a chakra-packed palm into %target, and the backlash spins around %user into a shimmering shield.

data.name: Body Flicker
data.description: The user vanishes in a flicker of speed and reappears at a chosen spot on the field. Their arrival lands as a sharp burst of chakra that strikes every enemy close by.
data.battleDescription: %user blurs out of sight and reappears across the field, striking at the enemies around them in the same instant.

data.name: Zephyr Smash
data.description: The user wraps their arms in volatile winds and smashes through the target's guard with a single punch. The swirling air clings to them, so the next hits they take bite deeper for a short while.
data.battleDescription: %user dashes at %target with winds swirling around their arms, landing a punch that bursts straight through their guard.

data.name: Wind's Embrace
