data.description: Verdant Bastion surrounds you with restorative flora, healing your wounds and increasing the healing received by allies within its reach.
data.battleDescription: With a surge of focused chakra, %user summons Verdant Bastion. Emerald foliage closes around %user's wounds while its restorative energy spreads across the area, strengthening the healing received by nearby allies.

data.name: Mori no Shugo
data.description: Summons a protective forest barrier.
data.battleDescription: %user summons ancient forest spirits, causing towering trees to erupt and form an impenetrable, healing barrier that blocks all attacks while restoring %user's Chakra.

data.name: Kijo's Benevolence
data.description: Kijo's Benevolence creates a protective aura that absorbs damage for allies and increases the healing they receive.
data.battleDescription: As %user focuses their chakra, Kijo's Benevolence spreads across the battlefield as a protective aura, absorbing harm for allies and strengthening the healing they receive.

data.name: Smokescreen Assault
data.description: Unleashes a smoke blast that obscures vision and chokes.
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a swirling gust mixed with smoke, obscuring %target’s vision and reducing the force of their attacks

data.name: Molten Fury
data.description: A genjutsu that deals damage and inflicts lingering mental burns.
data.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and initiates a searing genjutsu where molten lava pours from the sky, engulfing the target in a hellish illusion. Though the damage is purely mental, the torment lingers, causing %target to feel continuous internal burning that chips away at their psyche each turn. The illusion blurs reality, leaving them unsure if the pain will ever stop.

data.battleDescription: %user collapses their celestial chakra in on itself causing a deadly feedback chain reaction. Without notice the entire battlefield is engulfed in a blast of extreme heat as everything is pulled into Maia and destroyed.

data.description: An unstable enhancement technique born from early KX experimentation, KX Hollow Surge forces violent chakra throughout the user’s body to overwhelm nearby targets through relentless offensive pressure. Those struck by the surge find their defenses destabilized as the corrupted energy leaves them increasingly vulnerable to follow-up attacks.
data.battleDescription: Violent chakra erupts around %user as KX Hollow Surge tears across the battlefield, the unstable energy overwhelming %target and leaving their defenses exposed beneath the crushing pressure.

data.name: KGK: Black Fang Lance
data.description: A concentrated piercing technique utilized by Kuroganekai execution units to overwhelm enemy defenses through relentless offensive pressure. Black Fang Lance condenses violent chakra around the user’s strike, driving through targets with enough force to amplify subsequent attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user lunges while forging a spear of violet chakra and takes shape into a ravenous beast of energy roaring towards %target that tears forward in a brutal piercing assault.

data.battleDescription: %user makes eye contact, causing %jutsu to ensnare %target, making them believe they have been encased in water, while allowing %user time to heal themselves.

data.name: Deaths Countdown
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu. The air warps as black petals drift down, each one pulsing like the second hand of a clock. The battlefield grows suffocating, every breath heavier than the last.  “The countdown begins, %target… eight more turns ‘til you fall. Can you defeat us before the end?” The petals spread, gnawing at chakra and stamina with each passing moment. Every turn echoes louder, until the final, merciless detonation of Death’s Countdown.

data.name: Miasma Dominion
data.description: New jutsu description
data.battleDescription: %user uses %jutsu. A wave of venomous chakra erupts from %user, spilling into the battlefield as a choking haze.  “Welcome, %target, to my domain—every breath you take is now an investment in your suffering.” The poisonous mist coils around all combatants, leeching stamina and choking chakra flow. Each step, each technique, demands double the effort as the miasma seeps deeper into their bodies.

data.name: Singularity I
data.description: Abby exits the concept of relevance. Buffs and debuffs? Denied by existence itself.
data.battleDescription: With a snap of inverse will, %user releases a gentle pulse of paradoxal chakra—a ripple that unthreads cause and effect in a five-meter radius. Time hitches. Color desaturates. Snowflakes hang motionless mid-fall, unsure if they’re ice or metaphor. %user then phases out, entering a Null State where interaction becomes optional. Buffs skitter away like nervous fox spirits. Debuffs dissolve mid-flight. Even the air forgets how to cling to %user. For two full rounds, %user becomes a fixed point in a broken equation—not immune, just categorically incompatible. Attempts to empower or weaken them unravel before they’re born. %target’s enhancements fizzle into shame. There’s no resistance. No deflection. Just stillness. Just Abby.

data.name: Walk of the Forgotten
data.description: "To walk through Mictlan is not to die — but to remember everything that made you wish you had"
data.battleDescription: %user exhales a whisper of chilling chakra causing the world to shift for %target . They find themselves walking the path of Mictlan, a realm of frost and endless descent. Nine spectral gates appear, each colder than the last. Between them, the wails of lost souls echo. %target sees familiar faces among the dead —  illusions of their past failures, former comrades, or slain foes — and as they try to flee, the cold grips their limbs and the dead grasp at their soul.

data.name: Death Spine of Mictlan
data.description: “From the frozen depths of the underworld, the spine of death rips through the battlefield.”
data.battleDescription: %user causes the temperature across the battle field to plummet. The world becomes silent, the air thick with an unseen pressure. Reality fractures for %target , their eyes blur as they find themselves standing alone in an icy black corridor. Before them stretch nine frost-covered stone gates, each carved with images of skeletal priests and winged serpents. As they pass each one, spectral hands emerge from the walls, taking away their strength, stripping memory, erasing their will, and rewriting their purpose. Their own voice echoes in reverse as they attempt to cry out. At the final gate, they face their reflection — Dead; Frozen; Forgotten. They try to scream, but only haze escapes their breath. As the illusion breaks, they collapse to one knee, eyes wide with terror:- Something inside them was left behind.

data.name: Litany of the Devourer
data.description: A sacred litany spoken through relentless motion. Each verse is a bite, each strike a mouthful taken from flesh and spirit alike. The Devourer does not rush its feast. It drains, consumes, and forbids mercy, ensuring the offering is swallowed whole.
data.battleDescription: %user advances with measured devotion, movements repeating the Litany strike by strike. Each blow tears more than flesh from %target, siphoning strength, chakra, and breath into hunger. No cleansing follows. The wounds remain open, the body unable to purge the feast, as the Devourer continues to feed through the coming rounds.

data.name: Hymn of Absolution
data.description: Absolution is not forgiveness. It is correction through suffering. By spilling blood in sacred measure, the disciple weakens the unworthy and prepares herself to be restored through the rite that follows.
data.battleDescription: %user strikes with deliberate cruelty, the blow draining strength and certainty from %target. As the wound settles, a quiet calm returns to the devotee's breathing. When the next round comes, the Sacrament answers, knitting flesh as absolution is granted through pain.

data.name: Momentum Shift
data.description: Momentum Shift is a devastating control-oriented time jutsu that attacks the concept of motion itself.
data.battleDescription: As %target moves  %user snaps their hand forward, releasing a burst of tightly compressed sand infused with chakra. The sand collides with the %target’s halting their movement

data.name: Muryōkūsho
data.description: The user steadies their breath and asserts control over the space around them, creating an unseen barrier that blunts incoming attacks. Rather than stopping force outright, this distance causes strikes to lose cohesion before they can fully land.  Opponents who commit to attacking overextend in the process, leaving their defenses compromised. As a result, they take increased damage, paying the price for misjudging the space they attempted to cross.  The technique does not rely on force or aggression. It enforces separation, turning intent itself into a weakness.
data.battleDescription: %user exhales and settles into place, the space around him tightening into something unseen but absolute. The opponent’s strike falls short, their momentum carrying them forward into a misstep.  %user does not move. The distance holds. From that moment on, every blow against the opponent lands harder, the price of reaching where they never truly could.

data.name: Karmic Correction
data.description: Karmic Correction is a technique born from patience exhausted, not anger unleashed. It represents the moment when restraint gives way to consequence, and clarity decides that no further balance can be maintained without force.  Rather than overwhelming the battlefield with chaos, the technique condenses intent, awareness, and judgment into a single release. The initial strike is absolute, but its true weight lingers, manifesting as wounds that continue to deepen as karma settles its account. What follows is not cruelty, but inevitability.  Those who witness Karmic Correction often describe it as less an attack and more a verdict. Once delivered, the outcome no longer belongs to the user. The consequence has already been set in motion.
data.battleDescription: %user brings his hands together, invoking Karmic Correction, as violet energy collapses into a single, devastating strike that crashes into %opponent. The impact carves deep, lingering wounds that continue to tear at them even after the blow has passed, the full weight of their actions settling in as %user stands calm and unmoved.

data.name: Mictlan’s Cursed Road
data.description: "Before the dead reach peace, they must cross the frozen road of bones."
data.battleDescription: %user steps forward and slams his hand into the cold earth. An eerie pulse echoes outward — not like a shockwave, but like a heartbeat from beneath the ground. The terrain shifts violently, turning jet-black as spectral frost spreads in jagged patterns. The air freezes and howls with ghostly voices. Skeletal limbs and broken stone steps rise from the ground, forming a cursed road from Mictlan — etched with obsidian glyphs and slick with spirit frost. Movement becomes sluggish. Jutsu flow like molasses. Every step forward feels like it’s dragging through a grave. Walking ahead, already on the path, are footsteps letting you know your fate has already been decided.

data.battleDescription: The battlefield darkens as all warmth vanishes. %user raises a hand to the sky as black snow begins to fall. Behind them, a towering spectral form rises — the Bone Monarch. Cloaked in regal obsidian armor and wearing a crown of frozen thorns, he brings one bony finger to his face, gesturing for silence. With each breath, enemies feel the cold of death clawing at their lungs, and they envision ancient hands rising from beneath their feet. Chakra itself freezes, spirits crumble, and time feels as if it has slowed to a crawl. When the Monarch departs, he leaves only ruin and a cold silence.

data.name: Schrödinger Catboi’s Box
data.description: Abby slips halfway out of existence, forming a shimmering shell of semi-coherent defense.
data.battleDescription: %user exhales. Their chakra doesn’t flare—it fractures. Notes of it scatter into dimensional harmonics, and suddenly they are no longer fully present. Light bends. Sounds delay. Shadows fail to keep up. Caught between states, %user becomes a quantum blur of suggestion. Blows aimed at them lose impact, skipping like bad dreams on static. Even chakra begins to hesitate, unsure if it’s allowed to touch. As this anomaly stabilizes, a radiant shell—woven from warped moments and displaced space—forms around %user. Inside, time feels distant. Motion, optional. Battle is just a rumor. And in that perfect pause, %user reaches into their pouch…  and bites into a warm, freshly-roasted potato.  Crisp on the outside. Fluffy within. Reality has no defense.

data.name: Abby Paradox
data.description: Tear the timeline a little. Ride the rupture. Leave the enemy questioning their own hitbox.
data.battleDescription: In an instant of catastrophic serenity, %user pulses with distorted chakra—unfolding time like a bad map. Frost forms sideways, wind reverses its scream, and droplets of water hover mid-existential crisis. Without warning, %user flickers forward through an echo of future motion. The strike hits the opponent before it starts, severing balance, expectations, and likely a few laws of physics. Unmoored by time’s tantrum, %user rides the aftershock like a ripple through possibility, dragging fragments of past elements behind them—heat without flame, ice without cold, wind without direction.

This jutsu embodies the strength and resolve of the Traveling Sun Praiser, turning a simple tool of travel into a powerful weapon.

As it flies through the air, the rag glows with a blinding light. Upon contact, the rag releases a burst of purifying flames, burning %target and dispelling any dark or malevolent energies. data.name: Old Scroll from the Black Stone
data.description:
The scroll lay sealed within a black stone. How it came to rest there, one
can only wonder. Upon the scroll, these words are inscribed:

Upon the land of Fujin you stand, beneath his watchful eye,
But to the place you seek, three barriers lie
Waters of silver, three seas of blue,
Cross them with courage, the path will be true.
What is this place, where journey and quest,
Are separated only by three waters, no more, no less?

data.name: Sealed Binding Script
data.description:
The air is wrong.

Not heavy, not silent—just wrong.

The ruins before you should feel abandoned. Ancient. Still. Instead, the embers still breathe within the cracks of the stone. The ritual here has already been disturbed, but the remnants still pulse, whispering their unfinished purpose into the air.

At the center, a scroll rests upon the altar, its surface burned at the edges but still intact. The Sealed Binding Script. Even without touching it, you can feel what it was meant to do.

It was never a tool. Never an ordinary relic.

It was a lock.

And now, it is one step closer to breaking.

data.name: Drained Effigy
data.description:
The sun drips below the horizon, casting the world in dying gold. He stands there, just as he said he would, just as he always has.

But something is wrong.

His stance is too easy, his smirk too sharp, his gaze too knowing. The wind stirs his scarf, but the fabric feels heavier now, weighed down by something unseen. The air thickens, charged with anticipation.

Then he exhales, long and slow, as if savoring the moment.

"Tell me… Do you even know what you’ve done?"

The question is soft, almost disappointed. Almost. But beneath it, coiled tight, is something else—something dark and gleeful. His eyes, ember-bright, gleam like a fire fed new fuel.

"Running my errands. Gathering my offerings. Walking right into my hands."

His hair moves unnaturally now, twisting as though caught in an unseen current, tendrils of shadow laced with embers. The illusion is unraveling. And yet, he still smiles.

"The Maw thanks you, truly."

Then, without warning—he shatters.

His body folds inward, his limbs snap, his ribs split apart like a beast shedding its skin. A sickening crack echoes through the air as his form twists, lengthens, grows.

Flames bloom along exposed bone, devouring flesh like paper. His fingers become talons. His spine uncoils, extending into a whip of vertebrae. His face—no, his mask—melts away, revealing something ancient, something monstrous.

The last remnants of Dusk’s stolen visage peel from his skull, revealing the gaping maw beneath, lined with searing fangs.

"Come now…"

His voice is deeper, distorted, vibrating through the air like a crack of thunder.

"You did all this work—don’t you want to see what you’ve freed?"

Then he roars, and the world burns.

The monk receives Miyuna with a quiet, respectful nod. "She is safe now, in the care of our shrine," he says softly, though his gaze betrays a depth of thought he keeps hidden.

data.name: Night's Testament
data.description: “When the sun bears witness, this blade sleeps. When night falls, it remembers.”  Night’s Testament is not forged for war, but for judgment. Its edge is blackened not by fire, but by vows — each strike binding the wielder to the truth of what they’ve done. The markings along the blade are not decoration; they are testaments, etched as memories of every oath fulfilled and every silence kept.  In Seichi, it is said that:  the blade grows heavier with lies,  lighter with resolve,  and will not draw blood unless the wielder’s intent is absolute.  Those who survive its cut remember nothing. Those who fall become part of it.

data.name: Kamunari's Claw
data.description:
Kamunari's Claw is a legendary bow forged in the now-ruined village of Samui, known for its unparalleled craftsmanship and mastery over elemental forces. The bow is a relic of a bygone era when Samui was revered for producing shinobi with extraordinary skill in the art of archery and wind manipulation. The weapon is named after Kamunari, whose presence was said to be invoked during the bow's creation.


The bow is crafted from a rare wood found only in the highest peaks of the Hyuogaan Mountains, making it both incredibly durable and flexible. The bowstring is woven from the hair of mythical creatures known for their speed and strength, giving the bow an unmatched draw strength and accuracy. When drawn, the bow channels the power of the wind, forming arrows from the very air around it.

data.name: Kamunari's Claw's Mini Replica
data.description:
Kamunari's Claw is a legendary bow forged in the now-ruined village of Samui, known for its unparalleled craftsmanship and mastery over elemental forces. The bow is a relic of a bygone era when Samui was revered for producing shinobi with extraordinary skill in the art of archery and wind manipulation. The weapon is named after Kamunari, whose presence was said to be invoked during the bow's creation.


The bow is crafted from a rare wood found only in the highest peaks of the Hyuogaan Mountains, making it both incredibly durable and flexible. The bowstring is woven from the hair of mythical creatures known for their speed and strength, giving the bow an unmatched draw strength and accuracy. When drawn, the bow channels the power of the wind, forming arrows from the very air around it.


This is just a mini replica, NOT the actual Kamunari's Claw.

data.name: Lycanthropy
data.description:
The old sages tell that in the times of the first Seichi World War, a legendary lineage emerged, forged in the darkest corners of the forests. The lycanthropes, descendants of an ancestral clan that sought the aid of mystical beings in times of chaos and desperation, are renowned for their mastery of Taijutsu and their unique connection to the wild.

The saga of the Lycanthropy bloodline dates back to a forgotten era, when the leader of their clan sought the counsel of the Phantom Peak Guardians, ancestral entities who guarded the secrets of combat arts. In a pact with the mystical wolves of Iron Wood forest, some clan members were marked by the moon and blood, melding their being with the ferocity and cunning of these noble animals.

Endowed with superhuman abilities, lycanthrope ninjas are masters of savage Taijutsu, capable of defeating their enemies with unmatched skill and immense strength.

Their connection to nature grants them a unique tactical advantage; feared and respected, they embody an unpredictable force and a ferocity that defies the limits of possibility.

data.name: Namikaze
data.description:
In the remote and enigmatic Whirling Valley, the legend of an ancient bloodline is told, feared and revered in equal measure. The elders tell of a powerful shaman, consumed by an insatiable thirst for power, who desperately sought a way to master the storms ravaging the valley. In his obsession to control the wild winds and unleash their fury upon his enemies, he performed forbidden ancient rituals, invoking dark forces he did not fully understand.
It was in that moment of desperation and darkness that the shaman's blood became infused with the very essence of obscurity. This dark and twisted current of elemental energy intertwined with his lineage, marking his descendants with an innate connection to the wind corrupted by darkness, allowing them to control and manipulate the very air itself with malevolent intent.

data.name: Tenohira Musei
data.description:
In the heart of the Blackpeak Mountains, where the winds whispered tales of ancient rivalries, two clans stood in perpetual enmity. Their feud, born of ambitions to claim the coveted Plateau of Quietude, echoed through the valleys. Yet amid their strife, a peculiar bond existed between the leaders, masters of fire and lightning. Though driven by the primal urge to dominate, they harbored a grudging respect for each other's prowess.

 

One fateful night, a member of one clan sought to tip the delicate balance by ending the life of his rival. Igniting his chakra into a blazing inferno, he unleashed a fiery onslaught upon the unsuspecting leader. Witnessing this treachery, the leader's counterpart, instead of retaliating, rushed to shield his wounded foe. Moved by this act of selflessness, members from both clans rallied to his side, casting aside their animosity. Legend has it that even the moon deity, Tsukuyomi, shed a tear, blessing the moment with a celestial cascade of stardust.

 

From this union of formerly divided houses emerged the lineage of Tenohira Musei, inheritors of both fire and lightning. Their descendants, gifted with the ability to harmonize the two formidable elements, embody the equilibrium born from the crucible of conflict.

data.name: Aerathiel
data.description:
In the ancient annals of Current's genesis, the villagers remained oblivious to Fujin's unleashed fury within the valleys. But as raging tempests laid waste to their crops and made life a daily struggle, they erected an altar to appease Fujin's wrath, offering sacrifices for mercy. Though momentarily effective, peace proved short-lived.

 

On a fateful afternoon, children playing near the sacred altar accidentally desecrated it, reigniting Fujin's wrath. Hurricane-force winds tore through the village, reducing even the altar to rubble. Amidst the chaos, a young member of the Aerathiel lineage emerged. With unwavering determination, she faced the storm, her skin lashed by winds like a whip. Carrying a heavy stone from the ruined altar, she planted it where it once stood, offering her life for her people's salvation. Fujin, moved by her selfless devotion, softened, transforming the hurricane into a gentle breeze. Legend has it that Aerathiel descendants inherit divine mastery of the wind element, from destructive gusts to soothing melodies in wind chimes.

data.name: Taiyo Kami
data.description:
In the heart of the scorching Shining Dunes, a group of shinobi devotees of the sun sought solace amid the relentless heat.

Their prayers reached the ears of Amaterasu, who, moved by their resilience, bestowed upon them a divine blessing.

With a touch of Amaterasu's grace, the shinobi were divinely gifted, allowing them to harness their chakra and command the elements of fire and wind.

Through rigorous training and unwavering determination, they honed their skills, mastering the art of jutsu to wield flames and winds with unparalleled precision.

As the sun beat down upon the sands, the shinobi of Shine rose to prominence, their fiery spirits burning bright against the scorching desert.

With their newfound abilities, they became guardians of their land, using their jutsu to protect their people from threats both natural and supernatural.

Their legend spread far and wide, a testament to the strength and resilience of those blessed by Amaterasu's light.

And though the sands of time may shift and the winds of change may blow, the legacy of the shinobi of Shine will endure.

data.name: Youso Shiroi
data.description:
An echo of the old elemental discipline, struck from the founding line and held one remove away from it. Every branch is present and none of it is quite as bright: fire that smoulders, water that clouds, stone that crumbles at the edges.



It is the same shape, borrowed. It moves the same way for as long as you hold it.

data.name: Arashima
data.description:
In the barren expanse once known as Shroud, where desolation reigned and hope withered under the relentless sun, one clan dared to defy fate. As the land dried and fertility faded, most fled in search of greener pastures. Yet, the clan remained, their faith unyielding, their prayers to Susanoo echoing through the parched air.

For months, they prayed for rain, their devotion unwavering. In response, the Kami, viewing mortals with disdain, cursed the land with perpetual storms. But to the clan, it was not a curse but a blessing—a testament to their faith.

Embracing the tempests that ravaged their home, they settled amongst the rain, seeing it as a sign of divine favor. Their unwavering devotion and stubborn resolve moved Susanoo, who bestowed upon them a unique gift: the ability to master water and lightning. They became a force to be reckoned with, their bond with the elements unbreakable.

And thus, from the ashes of despair, the village of Shroud rose anew, its people blessed with the power to shape the very forces of nature.

data.name: Shakunetsu Sakura
data.description:
To know the Nikko no Hana lineage is to know the Sakura Dragon's Tree—for they are its avatars.

The ancestors of the Nikko no Hana lineage were blessed with the flames of the Sakura Dragon Tree, giving birth to their unique pink and violet fire release, along with an affinity for wind release.

Those who belong to this lineage possess absolute control over flame and wind, shaping embers into blossom petals and luring their foes into the dance of searing, violet-pink flame blossoms swirling on the breeze. These petals leave nothing but scorched earth for those who underestimate their beauty.

Rising like the first rays of daylight after a lightless night, the Nikko no Hana seek to astound the world with their scorching flames once more.

data.name: Houkyuken
data.description:
Formulated through decades of blood research, the origin of this bloodline is shrouded in secrecy, concealed within the ancient tomes of the Global ANBU. Unlike other bloodlines, the potency of this lineage does not stem from raw elemental prowess, but rather from its profound connection to Seichi's natural magnetic forces. By delving deep into the mysteries of the earth's magnetic fields, its wielders have unlocked the ability to manipulate the very makeup of their bodies, rendering them as the magnetic focal point of the battlefield.


Yet, despite their formidable abilities, whispers persist among the wise and wary. Some speculate that the true potential of this bloodline remains untapped, its depths yet to be fully plumbed. As such, there lingers a shadow of apprehension, a fear of the day when the Houkyuken may unlock the hidden secrets concealed within their lineage's ancient heritage.

data.name: Terra Nova
data.description:
Entrenched within the enigmatic confines of a secretive brotherhood and shrouded in veils of mystery, lies the lineage known as Terra Nova. Across generations, they have covertly cultivated their talents, delving deep into the ancient ways of earth manipulation and clandestine warfare. Once content to linger in the shadows, they now emerge, emboldened and resolute, ready to assert their dominance in the clandestine realm of ninja intrigue.

 

With a newfound sense of purpose, the descendants of Terra Nova cast off the cloak of secrecy, stepping forth into the light to unveil their formidable skills. Their mastery of the earth element grants them a formidable edge, allowing them to manipulate the very ground beneath their feet with precision and finesse. As they unveil themselves to the world, they stand poised to leave an indelible mark upon the annals of their clandestine brotherhood, their allegiance to secrecy, and their unwavering resolve guiding their path to prominence.

data.name: Ancient Tailed Demon
data.description:
The Ancient Tailed Demon lineage is not mere legend but a living legacy, tracing its origins to a profound union between a Nogitsune and a mortal. This extraordinary coupling bestowed upon their descendants an extraordinary gift; unprecedented regenerative abilities. The essence of both worlds flows within them, rendering their bodies nearly impervious to the ravages of time and injury. Their existence is a testament to the enduring power of this ancient bond, a tangible reminder of love's influence in Seichi's history.

Descendants of the Ancient Tailed Demon lineage are not only renowned for their exceptional regenerative prowess but also for their ability to heal beyond mere physical restoration, extending to the soul, and offering solace and resilience in the face of life's trials. As stewards of this sacred bloodline, they embody the strength of their ancestors and the resilience of the human spirit, serving as pillars of hope and inspiration in Seichi.

data.name: Loup-Garou
data.description:
As the rumors whisper through the ages, within the ancient tapestry of the lycanthropy lineage, tales unfurl of descendants, once part of a mighty clan in Seichi whose hearts were stirred by the enigmatic allure of the Fireheart Forest. They embarked on a journey that wove through the verdant depths of its age-old woodlands. Here, between the murmurs of nature's secrets and the ethereal dance of sunlight filtering through the canopy, they discovered a kinship with the enigmatic Wild Tribesmen who dwelled within.

Drawn by the untamed beauty of this sacred realm, these wanderers forged bonds with the indigenous tribes, their paths intertwining in harmony with the forest's ancient rhythms. Through unity and communion with the spirits that dwell within the Fireheart Forest, a new lineage was forged: a fusion of ancient lycanthropy blood and the primal nature of the Wild Tribes, embodying the essence of both human and beast. Endowed with this heritage, individuals demonstrate remarkable prowess in the art of taijutsu.

data.name: Heavenly Sonata
data.description:
Wrapped in mystery, the origin of the Heavenly Sonata bloodline remains elusive, shrouded in whispers and conjecture.

Rumors abound, suggesting that its members, practitioners of genjutsu, sought to master the melodies that unlock the gates of Yomi. Some even claim they succeeded.

Though the lineage's beginnings remain enigmatic, it is certain that its descendants possess a natural talent for music. They can wield any melody as a deadly weapon, ensnaring their victims within their genjutsu with celestial notes. Additionally, their potent mystical chakra grants them incredible proficiency with the fire, lightning, and Yin-Yang elements.

data.name: Nature's Blessing
data.description:
In the ancient scrolls of Seichi, the lineage known as Nature's Blessing unveils its enigmatic origins within the veils of time's passage and the whispers of ancient chronicles. Many versions of the story are inscribed upon the scrolls of time. Yet from all of the variants, one tale remains constant, echoed through the passages of countless chronicles: the story of a humble family of farmers ensnared by the cruel grip of a virulent plague that swept through their lands in the primordial days. Legends recount that Ninigi himself beheld their suffering and was moved to intervene. In an act of divine mercy, Ninigi is said to have bestowed upon them his sacred blessing, infusing their bloodline with the extraordinary gift to absorb the wounds inflicted upon them and transmute them into life-giving energy.

Descendants of Nature's Blessing lineage inherit this divine legacy, revered for their extraordinary abilities bestowed by celestial grace. Endowed with the innate capacity to absorb the harm inflicted by their adversaries, they harness this energy to restore their physical bodies. This profound communion with the forces of nature grants them unparalleled resilience in the heat of battle, drawing strength from the very essence of the world around them. As guardians of this sacred bloodline, they stand as steadfast sentinels of balance and harmony, their presence a beacon of hope amongst the tumultuous currents of fate.

data.name: Yaketsuku Netsu
data.description:
Within the annals of Seichi, the lineage of Yaketsuku Netsu emerges from the shadows of antiquity, its origins shrouded in enigma. The inaugural carriers of this bloodline hailed from a clan renowned for their mastery of Genjutsu and the fire element. Fueled by an insatiable hunger for supremacy, they embarked on a quest to conquer every technique and art known to shinobi, delving into the realms of Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, and Taijutsu. However, this relentless pursuit splintered the clan, fracturing them into practitioners of diverse disciplines. Today, only descendants of those Yaketsuku Netsu who dedicated themselves to the refinement of Bukijutsu endure. The original techniques of this lineage are deemed lost or forgotten, including those concerning the manipulation of the fire element.

 

In combat, the carriers of the Yaketsuku Netsu bloodline are renowned for their peerless expertise in Bukijutsu. Their ambition knows no bounds, propelling them to push the boundaries of their capabilities in the pursuit of victory. Gifted with a natural affinity for weaponry, they wield their chosen arms with grace and precision, striking fear into the hearts of their adversaries. Yet, behind their martial prowess lies an unyielding desire to reclaim the ancient arts of their lineage—a quest that propels them ever forward in search of forgotten secrets and untapped potential.

data.name: Teno Yuki
data.description:
A revered lineage that grants its wielders unparalleled mastery over illusions of devastating blizzards and cold storms. Born with an innate connection to the elements of water, wind, and ice, those with this bloodline possess a unique testament to elemental power with a force that unravels the boundaries between reality and illusion in the harshest of ways. Their artful manipulation of these elements transcends mere deception, offering a glimpse into the limitless potential that lies at the lines between illusion and the cold fusion of elements.

It is said that a couple, members of the Volcanic Tempest family, were expecting a child and, consumed by the idea of bestowing upon their future descendant an unparalleled power, ventured into the treacherous depths of Mount Meikan, seeking to forge forbidden pacts. However, fate had darker plans in store for them. Within the shadowed confines of the mountain, they encountered the ominous presence of Shikigami. With a chilling decree, he cast a curse upon them, foretelling that their firstborn would herald the dawn of a new bloodline—a lineage whose icy grip would spell doom for their kin.

data.name: Blue Blade Eyes
data.description:
Born from the union of mystic sorcerers, Blue Blade Eyes bear the legacy of channeling intense blue chakra through their eyes and weapons. With sapphire-hued eyes that ignite during battle, wielders infuse their strikes with pure energy, cutting through the toughest materials effortlessly. This bloodline's power peaks when chakra forms visible extensions of their weapons, creating devastating blades of energy.



In the twilight of the training grounds, Musa stood unwavering before a granite boulder. His chakra surged, eyes glowing like blue sapphires. With a swift motion, he split the rock cleanly in half, then summoned a crescent blade of sapphire energy, reducing the boulder to fragments. This display of precision and destructive power exemplifies the unmatched skill and raw power of the Blue Blade Eyes bloodline.



This is an S-rank bloodline and CANNOT be purchased directly

data.name: Shadow Weaver
data.description:
The Shadow Weaver Bloodline, steeped in the shadows of antiquity, remains an enigmatic tapestry woven with threads of mystery. Whispers of its origins echo through the corridors of time, yet the truth remains veiled in obscurity. How this lineage acquired its innate mastery over the elements of Lightning, Fire, and Shadow is a riddle that eludes even the most learned scholars of the arcane arts. Nevertheless, what cannot be denied is the unparalleled skill and mastery displayed by its practitioners in the art of bukijutsu.


Those who bear the mantle of the Shadow Weaver Bloodline are not merely wielders of shadows; they are artists who shape darkness into lethal instruments of war. With a flick of their wrist and a whispered incantation, they conjure forth shadowy weapons that dance and writhe with a life of their own. It is said that their connection to the essence of shadows runs deep within their very souls, granting them an intuitive understanding of the ebb and flow of darkness. In the heat of battle, they are a sight to behold, weaving shadows into a deadly symphony that strikes fear into the hearts of their foes.

data.name: Dai Kenja
data.description:
In the ancient scrolls of Seichi, the legend of this lineage is woven. It is told that in the dawn of the first era, a family emerged whose legacy was imbued with the very essence of Ninjutsu.

On a night of full moon, within a secret sanctuary deep in the Hyougaan mountains, the members of this family performed an ancestral rite. There, under the cloak of darkness and surrounded by the whisper of nocturnal winds, they channeled the energy of nature itself, merging it with their being.

Since then, each member has inherited this special connection with Ninjutsu, gaining an innate ability to learn and wield these arts with slightly greater proficiency than their peers.

data.name: Musashi Ken
data.description:
In the tumultuous days of yore, when the specter of war cast its shadow over Horizon, a fellowship of youthful warriors came together with a singular purpose: to master the art of Bukijutsu and ascend to unparalleled heights of skill and prowess.

In their quest to perfect their techniques, these warriors plunged into rigorous and arduous training, facing challenges that tested their courage and resolve. Though their knowledge of Bukijutsu far surpasses the average, the descendants of this lineage are aware that their journey toward mastery is far from over. Their tale continues to be etched upon the blade of their swords, and their legacy shall endure as long as there are stars in the firmament and warriors willing to pursue their dreams with unwavering determination.

data.name: Vaporia
data.description:
In the realm of myth and legend, tales of the Vaporia bloodline abound, each more fantastical than the last. Among the most enduring is the story of a mother who met her untimely end while traversing the uncharted eastern territories, cradling her infant in her arms. As she perished, her child was left alone upon the cold, unforgiving earth, wailing in despair. It is said that the anguished cries of the babe reached the ears of Seiryu, who, moved by pity for the hapless human, took it upon himself to nurture the child, infusing their essence with his divine blood.

 

Yet, beyond the old stories, one truth remains steadfast: the descendants of the Vaporia lineage possess an otherworldly mastery over the elements of water and fire. Coupled with their formidable prowess in Taijutsu, they wield these elements with unparalleled skill, seamlessly blending them at will. Legends may weave tales of divine intervention, but it is the tangible power and boundless potential of the Vaporia bloodline that commands awe and reverence throughout Seichi.

data.name: Blood-Enthralled Eyes
data.description:
Borrowed hunger. The blood answers, but it answers slowly, and it asks after. Bearers describe a second pulse running counter to their own, quickening when they wound and quieting when they mend.



Those who have carried it say the hardest part is not the taking. It is the giving back.

data.name: Eyes of the Forsaken Heir
data.description:
The claim without the crown. An heir carries the same fire in the eye and none of the authority behind it, which makes the fire louder and shorter.



Light gathers where the bearer looks, insistent as an argument nobody has agreed to yet.

data.name: Ethereal Monarch
data.description:
Born from the grief of a god who descended to earth after the tragic loss of his beloved wife, the Eyes of the Heavenly Founder bloodline carries a legacy of divine sorrow and unparalleled power. This deity, in his mourning, bestowed upon his descendants the ability to see and manipulate chakra in ways no mortal could ever comprehend. It is said that this god's tears, infused with celestial energy, crystallized into eyes that could pierce the veil of reality itself.

These divine eyes became the cornerstone for the creation of the four S-rank bloodlines in Seichi, each inheriting a fragment of their progenitor's immense power. The bearers of the Eyes of the Heavenly Founder are marked by their luminous, celestial eyes that glow with an otherworldly light, reflecting their godly heritage.

This is an S-rank bloodline and CANNOT be purchased directly

data.name: Itojinsei
data.description:
The Itojinsei bloodline originates from a lineage of skilled craftsmen and artisans who specialized in the creation and manipulation of wires. With generations of honed craftsmanship, the bloodline developed a unique connection to wires, unlocking a profound ability to control and utilize them in combat. This bloodline's members were revered for their precise wirework, becoming feared and respected warriors on the battlefield.


Many have attempted in the past to match the skills of these artisans, but their mystical connection to Seichi's magnetic field makes them unique in their abilities. Despite efforts to replicate their techniques, none have achieved the same level of mastery. Their creations are even considered works of art by some, admired for the precision and beauty with which they are crafted.

data.name: Sea-King's Blessing
data.description:
Caught in a tempest raging upon the boundless expanse of the sea, a husband valiantly sacrificed himself to safeguard his wounded wife from the clutches of a dark sea creature. Witnessing this act of noble bravery, the ancient Sea King bestowed his blessing upon the unborn child of the couple. From that moment forth, those born of this bloodline, deeply entrenched in the water element, have been marked by the grace and fortitude of the sea's depths. Their mastery over this element mirrors the fluidity and profound calm of the sea, and their connection with its waters enables them to move with unmatched agility and precision.

 

As these ninjas delve into the mysteries of their lineage, they pay homage to the sacrifice of their ancestors and strive to harness the power of water with wisdom and compassion. Their strength lies not merely in brute force, but in their ability to adapt and flow like the currents of the sea, empowering them to confront any challenge with unshakeable tranquility and determination.

data.name: Suragu
data.description:
A raw and powerful lineage passed down through the ages by the Suragu clan. The wielders of this bloodline have exact control over earth and fire to create lava, and its mastery will give them devastating power, making them capable of burning and melting anything and anyone in their path.


Legend has it that the origin of this bloodline is linked to the ancient lineage of the Ancient Phoenix, while others believe it to be a lost line of the Extinction Herald. Regardless, all agree that their ability and mastery, combined with their expertise in lava manipulation make them extremely formidable adversaries who should never be underestimated.

The extent of their power remains uncertain, only time will reveal what the future holds for this bloodline.

data.name: Astral Ascendant
data.description:
A reflected ascent. The bearer does not climb so much as remember climbing, drawing on a height reached by someone else and held only as long as attention holds.



The sky answers. It simply does not recognise the one asking.

data.name: Hyouga Yui
data.description:
Etched within the ice lies the tale of the origin of Hyouga Yui, a bloodline steeped in the frosty embrace of legend. In the early days of Seichi, when the first ninjas ventured into the Hyuogaan Mountains, Kuraokami, astonished by their audacity, issued them a challenge for his own amusement. He promised to bestow divine knowledge of the ice element upon them if they could endure a night there. The ninja clan of Hyouga Yui, confident and unwavering in determination, accepted the challenge. Kuraokami reveled in anticipation, conjuring an intense snowfall capable of chilling even the lava of a volcano. Contrary to what Kuraokami expected, this did not deter the ninjas. They stood proud throughout the night, showing no signs of pain despite the cold's toll on their bodies.

 

Impressed and surprised by their strength, Kuraokami fulfilled his promise, granting them both knowledge and a natural ability to manipulate the ice element. This gift has been passed down through generations, a testament to the resilience and valor of the Hyouga Yui lineage.

data.name: Blue Edge Eyes
data.description:
A thinner echo of an older sight. Where the founding line burned sapphire, this one runs pale at the rim, chakra gathering at the edge of a held weapon rather than flooding it. Bearers report the world arriving a half-beat early, outlines separating from the things that cast them.



The cut lands before the swing is finished. That is the whole of the gift, and it does not last.

data.name: Cosmic Ascendant
data.description:
Born from the essence of celestial phenomena, the Cosmic Ascendant bloodline draws its origins from a forgotten pact between mortal sages and the stars themselves. Legends tell of an ancient clan who meditated beneath starlit skies, seeking enlightenment and power. Their devotion did not go unnoticed by the heavens; a celestial being descended and imbued their lineage with the radiant energy of the cosmos. Inheritors of the Cosmic Ascendant bloodline are known to wield unparalleled control over the energies of the stars. They can channel constellations into their chakra, enabling them to manipulate gravitational fields, summon meteor-like strikes, and teleport across vast distances. Their mere presence is said to distort time and space, rendering them both untouchable and otherworldly on the battlefield.

This is an S-rank bloodline and CANNOT be purchased directly

data.name: Blood-Enchanted Eyes
data.description:
Once there was a goddess, born of lingering grief.

She watched mortality with the distant, childlike curiosity of eternity. She wondered at its fragility. At its endings.
At the quiet that followed a final breath.

And so she stepped closer.
And closer still.
Until she stood at the trembling edge between the here and the ever after.

There, she bathed in the twilight of What Was, What Is, and What Could Be.

And instead of recoiling, the goddess rejoiced.
She embraced the shadowed seam and made her home within it. She drank of the interval.
She consumed the in between.

From her, and from her children, and from their children after them, came those marked with her sight.

Eyes that do not close at the edge of death.
Hands that borrow moments not meant to be held.
Mortals who may taste eternity.

But never without surrendering something in return.

data.name: Ethereal Regent
data.description:
A throne kept warm. The regent holds every instrument of the sovereign line and none of its permanence, ruling on borrowed authority and returning it when the term is done.



Constructs answer. They simply expect to be dismissed.

data.name: Night Parade of A Thousand Demons
data.description: Long ago a small village was under threat of destruction. Sandwiched between 3 warring nations, each sought to claim the village as their own and demanded the chief swear loyalty to them. However, the chief knew that swearing loyalty to any one would spell destruction as the other two would surely attack. Secretly, he tasked his only daughter to go find help, but no one wanted to get involved and risk war from the 3 powerful nations. So, she turned to the only place she could, the underworld. She began making summoning contracts with smaller lesser powerful beasts, collecting allies until she had enough strength to recruit more powerful entities. And when she was finally done, she had amassed a force nearing a thousand. 999 Demons had made a contract with her, offering up a portion of their power. When the deadline came for the village chief to swear loyalty, his daughter returned with her new found power and struck down the ambassadors of each nation. Normally, this would mean eradication, however, she had become so powerful that she was able to take on the forces of all 3 nations with her summoned demons. When the dust cleared, all 3 nations were no more and that small village had annexed them all. Unfortunately, however, the village chief's daughter had to pay the ultimate price. By overusing the powers granted to her, she had, tragically, become a demon herself. The village chief had to seal her and her army away into his own granddaughter. With time and many wars, the village eventually was destroyed and the seal gradually weakened. Now on the night of a lunar eclipse, the moon tinted blood red, the seal finally broke and the Night Parade begins.

data.name: Eyes of the Forsaken King
data.description:
Long ago, before Shinobi walked the land, a family with extremely potent chakra existed. Rumored to have mingled with beings from the stars, they could control the flow of light and bend it to their will. The members of this family possessed unparalleled power, marked by their unique ability to manipulate light.



When the young heir became King, he was betrayed by his own family, who coveted his potent chakra. On the night of the attack, the King fought valiantly but was overwhelmed. With his dying breath, he plucked his own eyes out and sealed his powers within them. These eyes, known as the Eyes of the Forsaken King, hold the ability to manipulate light, making their bearers both revered and feared.



This is an S-rank bloodline and CANNOT be purchased directly

data.name: Bakuhatsu
data.description:
After years of research and development, the most destructive bloodline traits were engineered. The following documents were discovered by Global ANBU forces following a massive explosion and have been classified for an extended period. Recently, a portion of these documents has been made public.

 

[Unclassified]...

 Subject name: Hatsu, 19-year-old. Male. The subject is in excellent physical condition, and his mastery of the earth element makes him the perfect candidate for...

 

[Information damaged by the explosion]...

 

Subject name: Bakutai, 18-year-old. Male. The subject is in excellent physical condition and is the last known descendant of the Shockbolt Fiend bloodline. Everything is prepared for the fusion scheduled for tomorrow at dawn.

 

[Information damaged by the explosion]...

 

The fusion appears to have been successful. I’m still awaiting the subject's awakening, who I will be calling Bakuhatsu. For the moment, there seem to be no alterations in the subject's life force energy, but further assessments are pending.

...[Unclassified]

data.name: Crystal Essence
data.description:
In the hidden journey of the Void, deep within Seichi, young Aria discovered ancient, luminous crystals. These weren’t mere stones. They pulsed with energy and stories whispered that they once belonged to celestial warriors. When her village faced the menace of dark entities, Aria felt the crystals resonate with her spirit and she offered up her blood to fuse with them. Guided by age-old manuscripts, she learned to harness their power and to this day, the secrets of her teachings guide those who wish to make the crystallized bond.

Those fortunate enough to possess this bloodline are renowned for their expert mastery of crystals, fire, and earth. They stand as protectors of a celestial legacy, wielding their powers to safeguard the balance between realms and uphold the celestial order.

data.name: Godstorm Eclipse
data.description: Godstorm Eclipse was born when Eclipse's black-bone marrow and Aegis's dying storm were forced into one kind soul. One hand carries obsidian skeletal chakra, the other violet thunder. The bearer hardens bone into shadow armor, drinks wounds into marrow, and tears the sky open with the grief of a storm god.

effects.description: Godstorm Eclipse sharpens black-bone strikes and godstorm pressure.

data.name: Tetsugan
data.description: A rare bloodline that allows for control over metal

data.name: Megumi Kijo
data.description:
The Megumi Kijo Clan traces its lineage back to the ancient Hags of the Old Cabin, mysterious beings steeped in dark magic and chakra manipulation. Legends speak of a young girl named Megumi, whom the Hags took under their wing due to her exceptional talent.

Under the Hags' tutelage, Megumi honed her skills in Genjutsu, mastering the art of illusion to a degree unmatched by her peers. She delved deep into the secrets of her bloodline, uncovering the dark rituals and powers that defined her heritage.

As she matured, Megumi became a formidable force, using her abilities to protect her people and maintain the balance between light and dark. Her name, Kijo Megumi, became synonymous with fear and respect.

Today, the Megumi Kijo Clan remains a mysterious and feared presence, with its members carrying on the legacy of their ancestors. They are known for their mastery of Genjutsu and their unwavering loyalty to their lineage, ensuring that the dark powers of the Hags continue to influence the world.

data.name: Ha Yanagi
data.description: It is said that the origins of the Ha Yanagi lineage can be traced back to a time of great turmoil in Seichi. Seeking refuge from the chaos of war, a small community of mystics and illusionists banded together, their shared knowledge and affinity for Genjutsu serving as the foundation for what would become the Ha Yanagi bloodline. Through rigorous training and the passing down of ancestral techniques, they honed their skills to perfection, becoming revered as the foremost masters of illusion in the land. Legends spoke of their mesmerizing illusions that could ensnare even the most seasoned adversaries, casting doubt and confusion upon their foes. However, as time unfurled its relentless march, the Ha Yanagi lineage faced a gradual decline, their numbers dwindling with each passing generation. With each lost member, their once illustrious abilities faded into obscurity, leaving behind only whispers of their former glory,  a legacy tinged with both awe and lamentation.

data.name: Shinseina Ki
data.description:
In the heart of Fireheart Forest, where verdant foliage danced in harmony with the wind's whispers, resided a cadre of ancient spirits. Their ethereal essence infused the land with vitality and abundance, nurturing life within and beyond the forest's boundaries.

 

One fateful day, these benevolent spirits, curious about the lives of the humans dwelling at the forest's edge, donned human guise and ventured into the villages. Mingling among mortals, they forged bonds of friendship and empathy, enraptured by the joys and struggles of mortal existence. In a time when humans roamed as nomads, they stumbled upon this company and the splendor of the landscape, reasons ample enough to weave their dwellings into the fabric of this realm.

 

As time passed, the spirits grew deeply attached to their human companions, enchanted by their resilience and spirit. Some chose to relinquish their ethereal forms, embracing mortality to dwell permanently among the humans they had grown to love.

 

Through generations, the descendants of these spirit-human unions flourished, inheriting a potent legacy. Gifted with the ability to manipulate earth and wood, they became revered shinobi, guardians of the forest and its secrets. Their bloodline, infused with the ancient magic of the Fireheart Forest, endured as a testament to the enduring bond between spirits and mortals, shaping the destiny of the land for generations to come.

data.name: Shiroi Youso
data.description:
The archives of Seichi speak of a clan possessing the divine power to control and create elements. These shinobi, considered descendants of gods, can manipulate the natural world, shaping it to their will. With this volatile power, they can create and destroy at their whim, making them both revered and hunted.



Known as the Shiroi Youso, these bearers view the world as their own, molding it as they see fit. However, their immense power attracts those who seek to control it. The shinobi of this lineage constantly face threats from those who wish to harness their abilities for themselves, leading to a life of perpetual vigilance and conflict.



This is an S-rank bloodline and CANNOT be purchased directly

data.name: Oblivion Seal
data.description:
In the underbelly of Seichi, whispers tell of the Oblivion Seal, a cursed bloodline crafted by outlaw shinobi who willingly sacrifice their original lineage for control over shadows. This horrifying transformation is achieved through intricate rituals, during which shadow-tattoos, imbued with ancient and forbidden jutsu, are etched into the user’s skin. These living tattoos crawl across the body, constantly shifting and pulsating with dark energy.

Wielders of the Oblivion Seal are often shunned by society, as the process of obtaining this power is both dangerous and taboo. The Seal locks away the user’s original bloodline abilities, leaving them bound to the shadows. With this transformation, they become masters of the Void, capable of manipulating shadows in ways that strike terror into the hearts of their enemies. However, this power comes at a cost: the Seal grows stronger as it consumes the user’s chakra, gradually eroding their own power and leaving them dependent on the seal.

data.name: Shinrai Ou
data.description:
Their mastery over the mysterious Storm element gave them a natural command of lightning and water. Their power was revered, people called them one of two monikers: The Divine Thunder and The Kings of Water. Thus, they adopted the name Shinrai Ou, meaning "Divine Thunder King" to reflect the title bestowed upon them. Their original name has since been lost to time.
Currently, the descendants of this bloodline are famous throughout Seichi for their incredible skill and control over their powers. Heroes to some and villains to others, the members of this bloodline are both hated and respected equally, and their potential seems limitless. Yet, regardless of the varied opinions, none can deny the impact they have had on the world around them.

Whether their legacy will be one of salvation or destruction remains to be seen, but one thing is certain: the Shinrai Ou are destined to be remembered for ages to come.

data.name: Kyuko-sei
data.description:
In the depths of legend, the tale of the Kyuko-sei bloodline is inscribed with blood and ink upon a parchment guarded within the Temple of Izanagi. It recounts the story of Kyuko, a master of Ninjutsu, who witnessed her brother poised to seize the leadership rightfully hers upon their father's demise. Determined not to succumb to defeat, she infused her chakra with a Stone of Heraldry, renowned for its ability to cleanse one's bloodline. Once this bond was forged, she bestowed the stone upon her brother's wife, scion of the Endless Erosion family, in the form of an amulet.

 

She accepted the gift and wore it around her neck, unaware that the stone was draining the strength of her bloodline. However, instead of dissipating, this power flowed into Kyuko through the connection she had forged, granting her the strength to vanquish her brother. Thus began the lineage of Kyuko-sei, rising mighty in the mastery of wind and earth.

data.name: Sands of Time
data.description: Rank Reward Bloodline

data.name: Reptilian
data.description:
In the shadows of Seichi, the legend of the Reptilian bloodline weaves a tale of mastery in the art of Ninjutsu, tightly entwined with an ancient curse and the mysterious Black Komodos lurking in the darkest corners of the world. Eons ago, a band of daring ninjas ventured deep into the Swamp of Sorrow, a domain infested by the feared Black Komodos, seeking an ancient hidden power. Yet, their greed unleashed an ancestral curse, transforming them and merging their bodies with the reptilian features of the creatures they sought to dominate. Thus, the Reptilian bloodline was born, marked by an innate bond with the Black Komodos and their prowess in Ninjutsu.

Over the centuries, this bloodline honed their skills in camouflage, speed, and cunning, mirroring their reptilian ancestors. Though shrouded in mystery and curse, the Reptilians are revered throughout Seichi as masters of ninja arts, capable of slithering through shadows with reptilian grace and unleashing the power of Ninjutsu with deadly precision.

data.name: Primal Radiance
data.description:
Emerging as one of the most recent bloodlines in Seichi's history, Primal Radiance boasts a lineage with meticulously documented origins. According to ancient scrolls, a Taijutsu master, revered for their unparalleled combat skills, forged a binding contract with the enigmatic entity known as Onihitokuchi. This pact, sealed through a profound blood fusion, bestowed upon the descendants of this bloodline the rare ability to merge Taijutsu with primal energy.

 

Within those who bear the Primal Radiance bloodline burns a blend of raw physical prowess and the indomitable essence of primal forces. Every movement they make is imbued with the radiant power of nature, illuminating the world with their unmatched agility and strength. As they exist within the ninja landscape of Seichi, they rise as living embodiments of martial artistry, manifesting their connection with the radiant primal essence and leaving a trail of awe and reverence in their wake.

data.name: Voltara Divine
data.description:
Legend says that the members of this bloodline are descendants of a lightning deity thought by some to be the sacred Raijin himself. According to more obscure rumors, a god with a voice that roared like thunder once descended from the heavens and proclaimed that he would no longer wish to walk among his kin, choosing the human world as his new abode. The deity is said to have wed a human and sired a child who inherited their father's fearsome power to bend lightning to their will.

Forged in the crucible of divine lineage, the descendants of Voltara Divine are said to carry within them the very essence of lightning itself. As their bloodline courses through the veins of mortal vessels, it is whispered that they inherit not only the power to wield lightning but also the sacred duty to uphold the balance between the mortal realm and the divine. Guided by the echoes of their celestial ancestry, those of Voltara Divine walk the earth as living conduits of divine energy, their presence a testament to the enduring legacy of gods and mortals intertwined.
